# chezmoi-dotfiles

This machine's `$HOME` is managed by a **chezmoi** (configs) + **ansible** (system
deps) dotfiles repo. This skill is the agent-facing map: how to drive it, and what
custom tooling exists that you wouldn't otherwise know about. It is rendered per-host
— the "What's enabled on THIS machine" section reflects what the user actually
selected at init.

## Orientation (read this first)

- **Repo root**: `chezmoi source-path` (no args) prints the source dir. Work there
  to edit: `cd "$(chezmoi source-path)"`.
- **Source path of one file**: `chezmoi source-path ~/.config/foo/bar` → the
  managed source file for that target.
- **`docs/**` is NOT deployed to `$HOME`** (it's chezmoi-ignored). Read detail via
  `"$(chezmoi source-path)/docs/..."`. A *subset* is deployed to `~/.config/docs/`
  (e.g. keybindings, cli-tools) for runtime helpers.
- **Read the contract before editing**: `"$(chezmoi source-path)/CLAUDE.md"` holds
  Hard invariants and cross-file maintenance rules. Honor them.
- This host: profile `macos`, OS `darwin`/`amd64`, primary shell `zsh`.

## chezmoi essentials

```bash
chezmoi diff                 # preview changes (also: just chezmoi-diff)
chezmoi apply                # deploy + run scripts (also: cas, or just chezmoi-apply)
chezmoi status               # modified/added/removed targets
chezmoi edit ~/.zshrc        # edit the SOURCE of a target
chezmoi add  ~/.config/x     # start managing an existing file
chezmoi re-add               # pull live edits back into source
chezmoi managed | grep foo   # is X managed?
chezmoi cat ~/.config/x      # render a target without applying
chezmoi data | jq            # the template data (ground truth for the toggles below)
```

- **`cas`** = `chezmoi apply` + reload hint; **`cau`** = update from remote then apply
  (defined in `dot_config/shell/99_chezmoi_reload.sh`).
- **`dotcfg`** = reconfigure the init prompts on an already-set-up machine
  (`dotcfg` for the TUI, `dotcfg --set installLlmTools=true --yes` for one toggle,
  `dotcfg --dry-run` to preview). Shell twin: `czcfg`.
- **Never `chezmoi add` a `modify_`/`create_` target** — it overwrites the script.
- Full command cheat-sheet: `docs/this_repo/cheatsheet.md`. Install-vs-upgrade is
  split: `chezmoi apply`/ansible is **install-only**; upgrades go through
  `just upgrade-*`.

## What's enabled on THIS machine

(Rendered from this host's selections. For live truth: `chezmoi data | jq`.)
- **Coding agents** — Claude Code, OpenCode, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, Copilot (configs + CLIs). See `docs/tools/agent-overlays.md`, `docs/tools/agent-skills.md`.
- **Python uv tools** — mlflow, marimo, jupyter, etc. (powers the `mlf` CLI). See `docs/this_repo/uv-bootstrap.md`.
- **Extra runtimes** — rust, bun, ruby via mise (+ cargo/gem tools). Node is always present.
- **LLM tools** — Ollama / LiteLLM / local models.
- **JS CLI tools** — standalone npm CLIs (e.g. readability-cli).
- **.NET tools** — .NET SDK (mise) + dotnet global tools.
- **IaC** — Azure CLI, Terraform, OpenTofu.
- **Media** — ffmpeg, ImageMagick, exiftool, libvips.
- **Media control** — nowplaying-cli + switchaudio-osx (macOS) / playerctl (Linux); unlocks full `sysplay`/`sysnow` (built-in `sysvol`/`sysmute` work regardless).
- **Networking** — nmap, mtr, httpie, gping, trippy.
- **Tunnels** — ngrok, cloudflared (expose localhost to the **public** internet).
- **Tailscale** — WireGuard mesh VPN (tailnet-only, the opposite of the tunnel tools). Helper CLI: `tsnet`. Picker: `tv tailnet`. See `docs/tools/tsnet.md`, `docs/tools/Tailscale.md`.
- **Agent sounds** — audio notifications on agent Stop/Notification hooks. See `docs/tools/agent-sounds.md`.
- **Vim mode** — shell modal editing + tmux vim nav (NOT Neovim/editors — those are always vim).

## Custom in-house CLIs (always deployed to `~/.dotfiles/bin`, on PATH)

Each works from any cwd. Run with `--help`. Most have `docs/tools/<name>.md`, but not all (`x` → `clipboard.md`, `view-ebook` → `yazi-previews.md`, `fleet` → `this_repo/fleet-apply.md`); grep `docs/` if the obvious path 404s. Full list: `ls "$(chezmoi source-path)/dot_dotfiles/bin/"`.

- **`fleet`** — cross-host ops over your machines: `fleet chezmoi apply`, `fleet hosts`, `fleet tmux`, `fleet info`, `fleet pueue`, `fleet exec`. See `docs/this_repo/fleet-apply.md`, `docs/tools/fleet-exec.md`, `docs/tools/fleet-hosts.md`.
- **`mlf`** — MLflow umbrella CLI + TUI dashboard (needs Python uv tools). Picker twin: `tv mlflow`.
- **`pqsum`** — pueue queue summary (text / AI / JSON). See `docs/tools/pueue.md`.
- **`x`** — clipboard/file copy-paste-open with cross-platform fallbacks.
- **`view-office`** / **`view-ebook`** — open/preview Office docs (.docx/.xlsx/.pptx + legacy .doc/.xls/.ppt) and ebooks (epub/mobi/azw3, calibre-backed) in the terminal; also power the yazi previewers. See `docs/tools/office-viewers.md`, `docs/tools/yazi-previews.md`.
- **`mi-router`** / **`reyee`** / **`sms`** — read-only router CLIs (Xiaomi MiWiFi / Ruijie Reyee / Huawei HiLink SMS). See `docs/tools/{mi-router,reyee,sms}.md`.
- **`mi-dhcp-bind`** — opt-in **write** companion to `mi-router`: set/remove MiWiFi static DHCP reservations (`bind --self` autodetects this host). See `docs/tools/mi-dhcp-bind.md`.
- **`ping-monitor`** — record ping over time, flag latency spikes. See `docs/tools/ping-monitor.md`.
- **`wake`** — Wake-on-LAN sender: `wake <host>` powers a box on by magic packet (hosts in `~/.config/wake/hosts.toml`). Passive side = `installWakeOnLan` ansible role. See `docs/sysadmin/wake-on-lan.md`.
- **`tsnet`** — Tailscale helper: `tsnet list` (tailnet devices, `--tsv`/`--json`), `tsnet ssh-config <machine>` (idempotent managed block in `~/.ssh/config.d/20-tailscale`; detects the legacy no-`Include` case and shadowing `Host` blocks, both of which make ssh config silently inert), `tsnet serve <port>` (preflight → `tailscale serve --bg --https=443` → verify, for services that hard-require an `https://` origin), `tsnet doctor`. `--host H` drives any of it on a remote box over ssh. Picker twin: `tv tailnet`. See `docs/tools/tsnet.md`.
- **`agent-warmup`** — drive a real interactive agent TUI at a scheduled time to move the quota window (launchd/systemd/pueue). See `docs/tools/agent-warmup.md`.
- **`crash-blackbox`** — flight recorder for hard power-offs / unclean shutdowns. See `docs/tools/crash-blackbox.md`.
- **`nvidia-driver-drift-check`** — flag kernel-module vs userspace driver drift. See `docs/sysadmin/gpu-driver.md`.
- **`yth`** — search your YouTube watch history (title/channel/description + captions; Takeout import + optional cookie sync). Picker twin: `tv yth`. See `docs/tools/yth.md`.
- **`ytmv`** — download YouTube music videos for **old MP3 players**: mp3 + sidecar `.lrc` + ID3v2.3/USLT lyrics, or mp4 with soft/burned-in subtitles. Subcommands `get` / `lyrics` / `tag` / `doctor`; `ytmv help` is the complete setup/cookie-safety guide and `doctor --cookies` explicitly tests a configured source. Public downloads use packaged EJS + managed Node 22+ cookie-free first (doctor flags legacy Node 20/16). Compatibility profiles (`safe`, `cjk-big5`, `cjk-gbk`, `ipod`, `modern`) are re-appliable offline via `ytmv tag`. Needs ffmpeg (`installMediaTools`); `--burn-subs` needs the keg-only `ffmpeg-full`. No `tv` channel by design. See `docs/tools/ytmv.md`.
- **`appsrc`** — detect how an installed app / CLI was installed & managed (cask / App Store / direct-download / apt / snap / flatpak / AppImage / cargo/npm/pipx/uv/mise/go/gem / manual): `appsrc which <cmd-or-app>` (live), `appsrc size <app>` (footprint + associated cache/data/containers), `appsrc tui` (interactive dashboard — sort by size, filter), bare `appsrc` / `appsrc scan` (cached inventory, `--json`/`--tsv`/`--size`/`--sort`). Picker twins: `tv appsrc` (by source) / `tv appsrc-size` (by footprint). See `docs/tools/appsrc.md`.
- **`herdr-grep`** — search visible or retained content across panes in the current, one named, or all running local Herdr sessions; reports exact session/workspace/tab/pane coordinates, supports `--json`, and `--pick` pipes matches to fzf then exact-focuses/attaches the selection. Inside Herdr, `prefix+Alt+F` opens a visible-content picker (Alt+S = scrollback, Alt+V = visible). Remote use runs the CLI through SSH. See `docs/tools/herdr.md`.
- **`dotcfg`** — reconfigure dotfiles prompts (above).
- **`sesh-preview`** — preview helper for the sesh picker.

**`herdr`** is a first-class managed surface too (config in `dot_config/herdr/`, upgrade via `just upgrade-herdr` — which must NOT be run from inside a herdr pane): a remote pane/workspace server with three metadata pickers (`tv herdr-agent-panes`, `tv herdr-review`, `tv herdr-sesh`) plus `herdr-grep` for pane-content search. See `docs/tools/herdr.md` and the herdr entries in `pitfalls/`. Distinct from `wt` (worktrunk) and `wm` (workmux).

## Television (`tv`) — fuzzy pickers with custom channels

There are ~50 **custom** channels (system state, fleet, services, infra, agents…)
that you won't discover otherwise. Browse them:

```bash
tv                      # default picker
tv list-channels        # list everything available
tv <channel>            # open one, e.g. tv fleet-hosts | tv mlflow | tv pueue
ls "$(chezmoi source-path)/dot_config/television/cable/"   # the channel definitions
```

Handy ones: `fleet-hosts`, `tailnet`, `ssh-config`, `mlflow`, `pueue`, `ports`,
`kill-process`, `services`, `sessions`, `keybindings`, `aliases`, `git-ops`,
`mac-apps`/`linux-apps`, the agent trio (`agent-panes`, `agent-sessions`,
`agent-wakeup`) and the `herdr-*` family. Full reference: `docs/tools/tv.md`.

## Keybindings & keymaps

- **`bindings`** (shell function) or **`tv keybindings`** — interactive reference.
- **tmux**: `prefix + Space` opens the action menu. There is **no `prefix + e`** —
  that alias was removed, and `prefix + E` is "break every pane into its own
  window", so do not guess it. `prefix + T` = sesh picker, `prefix + U` = tools.
  Deep ref: `docs/tools/tmux/keybindings.md`.
- **shell ZLE widgets**: `Alt+S` sesh sessions, `Alt+T` tools, `Ctrl+R` history (atuin).
- Master reference: `docs/shells/keybindings.md` (also deployed to `~/.config/docs/shells/keybindings.md`).

## Aliases & functions

`alias` to list shell aliases, or `tv aliases`. Catalog: `docs/shells/aliases.md`.
Helpers worth knowing: `chezmoi-cd` (jump to source), `run-for` (time-box a command),
`bindings` (above). App control: `applaunch`/`appquit`/`apprestart`/… (cross-platform).
System audio (cross-platform, built-in): `sysvol`/`sysmute` (+ `sysplay`/`sysnow` with `installMediaControl`); remote mute via `fleet exec --login -- sysmute on`.

## just recipes (run from the source dir)

```bash
cd "$(chezmoi source-path)" && just --list
```

Categories: `chezmoi-*`, `ansible-*`, `upgrade-*` (brew/mise/uv/npm/cargo/…),
`fleet`/`fleet-*`, `gen-prompts` (regenerate prompt scaffolding), `check`/`lint`,
`docker-*`. See `docs/this_repo/cheatsheet.md`.

1	# Dotfiles Repository — Agent Contract
2	
3	Cross-platform dotfiles managed by **chezmoi** (configs) + **ansible** (system deps). This file is the agent-facing contract: edit rules and cross-file invariants. User-facing intro: [README.md](README.md).
4	
5	> **Headroom rule**: keep this file under ~30k chars. Push handbook content into `docs/`; keep only rules an agent must obey *without* opening another file. `AGENTS.md` and `GEMINI.md` are symlinks to this file — edit one.
6	
7	## Cross-file maintenance rules
8	
9	When you touch one of these surfaces, update the listed mirror in the same commit.
10	
11	| Surface you change | Also update | Reference |
12	|---|---|---|
13	| Config files / ansible roles / platforms / setup steps | `README.md` (What You Get, Supported Platforms, Quick Setup) | — |
14	| Console logging in any shell script | **Never re-hand-roll `info`/`warn`/`success`/`error` + a colour block** — `scripts/lib/log_shared.sh` is the SSOT for 13 consumers. run-scripts `{{ include }}` it (they render to a temp path) and MUST set `LOG_STREAM=stdout` first, or fleet-apply's local-host `_classify_drift()` demotes their stderr from `drift` to `failed`; `scripts/*.sh` `source` it; `$HOME`-deployed files can't use it (`scripts/**` is chezmoi-ignored). Editing it rehashes every `run_onchange_after_*` that inlines it → full ansible + brew re-run everywhere, so batch edits. New consumer → add it to the wiring guard in `tests/unit/log_shared.bats`. | [shell-logging](docs/this_repo/shell-logging.md) — API, config vars, and the `set -e`/`set -u`/`IFS`/top-level-`return` traps |
15	| New `docs/**/*.md` | Nav entry in `mkdocs.yml`; run `uv run mkdocs build --strict` | known anchor-drift is tracked in [`backlog/mkdocs-anchor-drift.md`](backlog/mkdocs-anchor-drift.md) — don't tighten `validation.links.not_found` until cleared |

50	### Workmux status icon integration spans 6 files
51	
52	The `🤖`/`💬`/`✅` per-tmux-window status mechanism spans **6 surfaces that must move together** — devtools install, `dot_config/workmux/config.yaml`, `dot_config/tmux/theme.catppuccin.conf`, `dot_claude/modify_settings.json.tmpl` hooks, `dot_config/opencode/plugins/workmux-status.ts` (+ its `modify_package.json`), and `dot_config/shell/60_tmux_status.sh`'s producers API. Exact contents: [workmux.md](docs/tools/workmux.md) § Status icon mechanics; why it leaks: [workmux-status-leak.md](pitfalls/workmux-status-leak.md).
53	
54	**Hard rules**: never run `workmux setup` on a managed machine (writes parallel hook entries); never flip `status_format: true` (fights catppuccin's window-text override); never drop the `command -v workmux >/dev/null 2>&1 && … || true` guard in Claude hooks (spams errors on fresh boxes); never drop explicit `set-window-status done` from `Stop`/`SubagentStop` (upstream only ever sets `working`, never clears). The workmux hook entries are **unconditional** — the `agentSounds` prompt gates only the notify.sh / peon-ping entries in the same file. `wt` (worktrunk) and `wm` (workmux) stay distinct tools.
55	
56	### Long-term backlog + past pitfalls → use the `project-knowledge-harness` skill
57	
58	This repo uses the `project-knowledge-harness` agent skill (restored on every `chezmoi apply`; see [agent-skills.md](docs/tools/agent-skills.md)). **Load the skill** for the template and disambiguation table.
59	
60	**Fallback rules**, so this still binds when the skill can't be loaded:
61	
62	- Three repo-root surfaces, all chezmoi-ignored, all NOT auto-redacted: [`TODO.md`](TODO.md) (tags `P1`/`P2`/`P3`/`P?` × `S`/`M`/`L`/`XL`), [`backlog/`](backlog/README.md) (notes for `P?` / `[L]` / `[XL]` / multi-option), [`pitfalls/`](pitfalls/README.md) (debugged traps — **title by symptom, not root cause**, verbatim error messages, never paraphrase).
63	- Capture triggers — future work: "maybe later", "nice to have", "工程量太大需要再評估", "先記下來". Pitfalls: >~15 min debugging, not googleable, non-obvious fix, silent failure.
64	- Do **not** spawn `ROADMAP.md` / `IDEAS.md` / `LESSONS.md` / `TROUBLESHOOTING.md`. Three surfaces, always.
65	- A pitfall *graduates* to a Hard invariant below when it recurs across machines, silently corrupts state, or has a non-obvious workaround. Link back to `pitfalls/<slug>.md`.
66	
67	## Chezmoi templating conventions
68	
69	**Hard rule**: before adding `{{ if eq .profile … }}`, ask whether the predicate is auto-detectable. If yes, use `.chezmoi.os` (`darwin`/`linux`) / `.chezmoi.arch` (`arm64`/`amd64`) / `.chezmoi.hostname`. `.profile` is for **user-role choices only**, and its values are limited to `macos`, `ubuntu_desktop`, `ubuntu_server` — do **not** introduce new values for OS/arch facts. `.profile` is still the right knob for desktop-vs-headless.
70	
71	**Hard rule — prefer XDG paths.** When a tool supports both a `$HOME`-root dotfile and an XDG path (`~/.config/<tool>/…`), manage the XDG copy (`dot_config/<tool>/…`) to keep `$HOME` tidy; only use a root dotfile when the tool can't read XDG. For tools that error when *both* paths exist (e.g. AeroSpace), also remove the legacy root file via a gated `.chezmoiremove` entry. Full rule + lookup-order caveats: [docs/this_repo/config-conventions.md → A1](docs/this_repo/config-conventions.md).
72	
73	Predicate table, examples, the `macos_intel` migration: [chezmoi-templating.md](docs/tools/chezmoi-templating.md).
74	
75	## Hard repo invariants
76	
77	### Validate app configs with the app, not just syntax
78	
79	YAML / TOML / JSON syntax and template rendering are not enough. If the app exposes a config check, parser, dry-run, or debug command, run it against the rendered config before declaring done (`codex debug …` for `~/.codex/config.toml`; `tmux source-file` / `display-menu` smoke; `mkdocs build --strict` for docs; for Ansible the narrowest practical play/tag/check-mode or container smoke — `--syntax-check` alone is only a first pass). If a validator cannot be run, say so explicitly in the final report and name the missing command/host/credential.
80	
81	### `primaryShell` choice gates `chsh` only — both shells always deploy
82	
83	`primaryShell` (`zsh` | `bash`, default `zsh`) **only** governs which login shell `chsh` switches to. Both `~/.zshrc`, `~/.bashrc`, `~/.config/{shell,zsh,bash}/` deploy everywhere — users routinely drop into the other shell ad-hoc.
84	
85	**Hard rules**:
86	
87	- Do **not** add `{{ if eq .primaryShell … }}` gates around `dot_zshrc.tmpl`, `dot_bashrc.tmpl`, or `dot_config/{shell,zsh,bash}/**`.
88	- Do **not** gate the zsh / bash ansible roles' **package install** task on `primary_shell` — only `chsh` is gated. macOS bash 5.x brew install + `/etc/shells` whitelist are gated on `primary_shell == "bash"` (zsh-primary mac users skip the brew formula).
89	- Do **not** rely on `$SHELL` — it reflects `/etc/passwd`, lags `chsh` until next login. Use `$ZSH_VERSION` / `$BASH_VERSION`.
90	
91	The ble.sh + oh-my-bash 12-step init order in `dot_bashrc.tmpl` is load-bearing: `ble.sh --attach=none` MUST source before bash-preexec/starship; `ble-attach` MUST be last before secrets/adhoc; OMB's `autosuggestions`/`syntax-highlighting`/`history-substring-search` MUST be excluded (double-init flicker). [bash.md](docs/shells/bash.md).
92	
93	### Three-tier user-local override layer
94	
95	User overrides live in **six** untracked files, all in `.chezmoiignore.tmpl`: shared POSIX (`~/.shellrc.adhoc`, `~/.shellrc.secrets`) and per-shell (`~/.zshrc.adhoc`, `~/.bashrc.adhoc`, `~/.config/zsh/secrets.zsh`, `~/.config/bash/secrets.sh`). Default target: shared; drop to per-shell only when shell-specific syntax is required.
96	
97	**Load order** in both `dot_zshrc.tmpl` and `dot_bashrc.tmpl` — `managed modules → shared secrets → per-shell secrets → shared adhoc → per-shell adhoc`. Secrets before adhoc (so adhoc can read secret vars); shared before per-shell (per-shell wins on conflict).
98	
99	**Hard rules**: never add the shared files to chezmoi management; never auto-stub the `*.secrets` files (empty secrets footgun); the shared adhoc stub heredoc lives in BOTH `dot_zshrc.tmpl` AND `dot_bashrc.tmpl` (first shell to run wins; second sees the file and skips) — keep both heredoc bodies in sync. Full matrix: [adhoc-and-secrets.md](docs/shells/adhoc-and-secrets.md).
100	
101	### `enableVimMode` gates shell + tmux vim, NOT Neovim or editors
102	
103	`enableVimMode` (bool, default `true`) gates **shell modal editing + tmux vim navigation only**. Neovim and every editor config (VSCode/Cursor/Antigravity/Codex/OpenCode/Cursor-CLI) are **never** affected. Full catalog of the 7 gated templates + 2 first-seed files: [vim-mode.md](docs/this_repo/vim-mode.md).
104	
105	**Hard rules**:
106	
107	- Do **not** gate anything under `dot_config/nvim/` — Neovim is inherently vim by design.
108	- Do **not** gate editor configs (`.chezmoitemplates/editor/`, `dot_codex/`, `dot_config/opencode/`, `dot_cursor/`) — the flag's semantic is shells + tmux only. Editors want vim → install the editor's vim extension.
109	- Do **not** broaden the gate to `bindkey -M viins`/`vicmd` calls inside `dot_config/zsh/tools/*.zsh` — harmless no-ops without zsh-vi-mode loaded.
110	- The `minimal` bundle forces `enableVimMode = False` (CI/Docker). Don't change without an explicit request.
111	- New vim-touched file → follow the gate-it-or-not flow in [vim-mode.md](docs/this_repo/vim-mode.md) → "For maintainers", and add it to the catalog table there.
112	
113	### Install vs upgrade is split on purpose
114	
115	`chezmoi apply` + ansible is **install-only** (`state: present`, `creates:`). Explicit upgrade path: [`scripts/upgrade_tools.sh`](scripts/upgrade_tools.sh) via `just upgrade-*`. `scripts/**` is in `.chezmoiignore.tmpl`, so the upgrade script runs from the repo, never deployed.
116	
117	**Hard rules**:
118	
119	- Do **not** rewrite ansible roles to `state: latest`.
120	- Do **not** add `apt upgrade` / system package bumps to default scope.
121	- **Minimum-version exception**: a role MAY auto-upgrade a *single* tool inside `chezmoi apply` when it genuinely needs a newer one (`python_uv_tools` needs `uv >= 0.8.5`). It MUST detect the install style and dispatch — never blindly `uv self update` (silent no-op on brew uv) or `brew upgrade uv` (errors when it isn't a formula). The dispatch helper is mirrored in `scripts/upgrade_tools.sh::cat_uv()` and the role. See [uv-bootstrap](docs/this_repo/uv-bootstrap.md), [uv-self-update-homebrew-noop.md](pitfalls/uv-self-update-homebrew-noop.md), [ansible-when-regex-replace-backslash-strip.md](pitfalls/ansible-when-regex-replace-backslash-strip.md).
122	- **`with_executables_from:` entries MUST also declare `extra_binaries:`** in `dot_ansible/roles/python_uv_tools/defaults/main.yml`, or the install guard short-circuits and entry-point shims are never written (silently missing `jupyter` despite `jupyter-lab` present). Audit command: [uv-tool-install-creates-guard-misses-executables-from.md](pitfalls/uv-tool-install-creates-guard-misses-executables-from.md).
123	- New upgrade category: [upgrades.md](docs/this_repo/upgrades.md) § Adding a new category. Tool already managed by brew/uv/npm/cargo/dotnet/gem/mise → do nothing, generic `upgrade` picks it up.
124	- **Probe `brew` by output, never exit status** — `[[ -n "$(brew --prefix 2>/dev/null)" ]]`. A stub `brew` passes `command -v brew` and returns 0 with empty output for *every* subcommand: `brew bundle` silently installs nothing and `community.general.homebrew` dies on `Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)`. [ansible-homebrew-expecting-value-line-1-column-1.md](pitfalls/ansible-homebrew-expecting-value-line-1-column-1.md)
125	
126	### Sudo session is shared across all run-scripts
127	
128	All three `run_*` scripts share one sudo session via `scripts/lib/sudo_shared.sh` — user prompted once at `chezmoi apply` start, reused silently downstream.
129	
130	**Hard rules**:
131	
132	- Do **not** re-implement `sudo -k` / `sudo -v` / TTY-read logic. Call the shared helper.
133	- Do **not** run `sudo -k` (invalidates the cache for the whole flow).
134	- Do **not** register a `trap … EXIT` that removes state (next run-script needs it).
135	- Do **not** read the password into a shell variable. Always `sudo -S <file`.
136	- Do **not** replace `_sudo_spawn_watchdog`'s `setsid`/`nohup` fallback with bare `setsid` — macOS lacks `setsid(1)` in base, the backgrounded failure is silent (redirected to `/dev/null`), and every run-script then re-prompts because `_sudo_state_valid`'s `kill -0` probe finds a dead PID. See [`pitfalls/sudo-shared-setsid-macos.md`](pitfalls/sudo-shared-setsid-macos.md).
137	
138	**Adding a new sudo surface in a run-script**: `{{ include "scripts/lib/sudo_shared.sh" }}` near the top → set the `NEED_SUDO` template flag → `sudo_session_init "yourlabel"` and branch on its return code + `sudo_session_skip_reason` → run privileged commands via `sudo_run …` (or `-e @$CHEZMOI_ANSIBLE_BECOME_FILE` for ansible).
139	
140	For **non-interactive** injection (`scripts/fleet/apply.py` over SSH), `sudo_session_init` adopts `CHEZMOI_SUDO_PASSWORD_FILE` (0600) instead of prompting on `/dev/tty` — **never** read that variable directly, always go through the helper. Full API + state + cleanup model: [sudo-session.md](docs/this_repo/sudo-session.md).
141	
142	### fleet-apply counter-intuitive defaults
143	
144	Full docs: [`docs/this_repo/fleet-apply.md`](docs/this_repo/fleet-apply.md). Load-bearing invariants:
145	
146	- **`drift` ≠ `failed`**. When chezmoi can't prompt to overwrite a hand-edited file (no PTY over SSH), the host shows yellow ⚠ `drift` with paths listed — it does **not** count toward exit code. Don't auto-"fix" drift unless asked; hand-fix the remote, or `--force` to let the template win.
147	- **`fleet-apply-file PATH` skips `run_*` scripts** (`chezmoi apply --exclude=scripts`), so ansible / Brewfile changes will NOT execute — use full `fleet-apply` for those.
148	- **`--branch BRANCH` is a no-op on local hosts** (the local source dir IS your editor working tree): they warn and run against the working tree as-is. The flag also forces mode to `apply`.
149	- **Install-only by design.** `just upgrade-*` must run on each host; fleet-apply does NOT broadcast upgrades.
150	- **Process substitution + sentinel are load-bearing**: `> >(tee -a $log) 2>&1 & _cz_pid=$!; wait $_cz_pid; _rc=$?; echo $_rc > $sentinel`. `--status` / `--tail` / `--watch` + SIGHUP trap depend on `$_cz_pid` pointing to chezmoi, not tee. Don't change to a pipeline.
151	- **Conservative drift classifier**: `_classify_drift()` only downgrades stderr lines matching the exact `chezmoi: <path>: could not open a new TTY: open /dev/tty:` fingerprint; anything unrecognised stays `failed`. Don't broaden without an explicit request — silent downgrades hide real errors.
152	- **`fleet-status` ≠ `fleet-apply-status`** — easy to confuse. `just fleet-status` is the **pre-flight readiness probe** (13 states; always exits 0 — use `--readiness-json | jq` for scripted gates; `fleet-status-quick` skips the remote `git fetch`). `just fleet-apply-status` is a **process-liveness probe** of `~/.cache/fleet-apply/<host>.{pid,sentinel,log}`, run during/after, pairing with `fleet-apply-tail`/`-watch`/`-kill`. State meanings incl. `toml-mismatch`: [fleet-apply.md](docs/this_repo/fleet-apply.md).
153	- **`fleet-edit` + `fleet-status` are forgiving** (auto-seed / exit 0 with a hint); `fleet-apply` keeps strict exit-2 on missing inventory. Don't unify.
154	
155	### `modify_` and `create_` prefix semantics
156	
157	- **`modify_`** files are executable scripts: chezmoi pipes the current target contents to stdin and expects the new contents on stdout. Used wherever a *foreign writer* also owns part of the file — `~/.claude/settings.json`, editor `settings.json`, the agent CLI configs, `~/.config/herdr/config.toml`, `~/.gitconfig` (preserves the `[credential]` blocks `gh auth setup-git` injects). **Never** `chezmoi add` a `modify_` target — it overwrites the script with the live file.
158	- **`create_`** files seed once; chezmoi never touches the contents after (`~/.config/nvim/lazy-lock.json`, editor `keybindings.json`). Refresh the baseline by copying directly: `cp <target> "$(chezmoi source-path <target>)"` — `chezmoi add` strips the prefix and `chezmoi re-add` silently skips.
159	
160	Per-file case studies + presence-gating in `.chezmoiignore.tmpl`: [chezmoi-prefixes.md](docs/tools/chezmoi-prefixes.md). The three agent CLI overlays, incl. the Claude hook merger that coexists with [CodeIsland](https://github.com/wxtsky/CodeIsland) without ping-ponging: [agent-overlays.md](docs/tools/agent-overlays.md).
161	
162	### Tmux popup menu: ≥ 3.3 required + must fit terminal height
163	
164	The popup menu (`prefix + Space` / `prefix + e`) is **generated** by `~/.config/tmux/menu.sh`, not inline in `keybindings.conf`. Two tmux quirks force that: `display-menu -x R -y P` is silently suppressed on tmux 3.2a (Ubuntu 22.04 apt) instead of clamped — the `devtools` role auto-upgrades Debian/Ubuntu past it — and `display-menu` does **not** paginate, so a menu taller than the terminal is suppressed entirely, with no error anywhere.
165	
166	**Hard rules**:
167	
168	- **Top menu cap ≈ 14 rows**. Generator reads `#{client_height}` and tier-trims; retest at heights 14 / 22 / 60 when changing tiers. Push lower-frequency items into category submenus.
169	- **Submenus = separate scripts**, each `exec tmux display-menu …`. Quoting context resets per script.
170	- **Complex commands** (anything with `{`, `}`, `;`, backticks, nested fzf binds) MUST live in their own script. tmux's parser treats `{}` / `;` as command-block delimiters even inside `'…'` inside `"…"`, silently aborting parse.
171	- **Test by shrinking the terminal vertically**. Full-height verification does not catch the height-fit failure.
172	
173	Full story incl. the red herrings: `pitfalls/tmux-display-menu-silent-fail.md`, `pitfalls/yazi-tmux-popup-crash.md`.
174	
175	### Key tmux settings for coding agents
176	
177	Non-obvious settings other tools depend on; do not remove without checking:
178	
179	- `extended-keys on` + `terminal-features 'xterm*:extkeys'` — forwards Shift+Enter, Ctrl+Enter, Ctrl+/, Ctrl+digit to inner apps. **Never use `always`** — re-encodes EVERY `Ctrl+letter` as CSI-u including the LF (Ctrl+J) embedded in pasted multi-line text → ble.sh inserts `^[[106;5u` literally instead of newline. See `pitfalls/tmux-extended-keys-always-paste.md`.
180	- `escape-time 0` — eliminates ESC delay for Neovim.
181	- `set-clipboard on` + `terminal-features …:clipboard` (for `xterm*`, `ghostty*`, `alacritty*`) — OSC 52 over SSH without terminfo `Ms`. Paired with SSH-conditional `vim.g.clipboard = vim.ui.clipboard.osc52` in `dot_config/nvim/lua/config/options.lua`. See [docs/tools/tmux/README.md → OSC 52 Clipboard](docs/tools/tmux/README.md).
182	- `allow-passthrough on` — OSC passthrough for terminal images.
183	- macOS terminals must send Option as Meta/Esc+ for `M-` keybindings (theme switching, layouts, fine resize). Ghostty/cmux: `macos-option-as-alt = left` in `dot_config/ghostty/config`. See [ghostty.md](docs/tools/ghostty.md).
184	
185	Full breakdown / themes / keybindings / troubleshooting: [](docs/tools/tmux/).
186	
187	### Zellij `default_mode "locked"`
188	
189	`dot_config/zellij/config.kdl` sets `default_mode "locked"` on purpose — all keys pass through to inner apps, `Ctrl+G` unlocks Zellij's own. Do **not** change it. Fresh box → pick the "Unlock-First (non-colliding)" preset. [keyboard-shortcuts.md](docs/keyboard-shortcuts.md)
190

1	# AGENTS.md
2	
3	This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) and other coding
4	agents when working with code in this repository. `CLAUDE.md` is a symlink to this file.
5	
6	## What this is
7	
8	Standalone, **Windows-only** dotfiles managed by [chezmoi](https://chezmoi.io),
9	targeting **PowerShell 7 (pwsh)**. It is a companion to the cross-platform
10	macOS/Linux repo `daviddwlee84/dotfiles` — the PowerShell layer is written
11	natively, **not** ported from that repo's POSIX shell config. No ansible;
12	packages install via **scoop** (CLI) + **winget** (GUI). Published at
13	`github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles-windows`.
14	
15	**Dev box vs target:** the deploy target is Windows, but this checkout is usually
16	edited on macOS/Linux. You therefore **cannot execute the `.ps1` run-scripts
17	here** (they call winget / `%APPDATA%`). Validate with the isolated-apply +
18	render/parse pattern below; the `windows-latest` CI is the real gate.
19	
20	## Commands
21	
22	Real machine:
23	
24	- `chezmoi apply` / `chezmoi diff` (or `just apply` / `just diff`)
25	- `just upgrade-scoop` / `just upgrade-winget`
26	
27	Validate locally (needs a local pwsh, e.g. installed to `~/.local/bin/pwsh`):
28	
29	- Lint: `pwsh -NoProfile -c "Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Path . -Recurse -Settings ./PSScriptAnalyzerSettings.psd1"` (fails only on Error; the excludes are deliberate — see the settings file header)
30	- Tests: `pwsh -NoProfile -c "Invoke-Pester -Path ./tests"` (single file: `Invoke-Pester -Path ./tests/Copilot.Tests.ps1`)
31	- Docs: `just docs-build` (= `uv run --with mkdocs-material --with mkdocs-static-i18n mkdocs build --strict`)
32	
33	Isolated apply + template render (the core idiom for testing without a Windows
34	box — all chezmoi state is redirected to a temp dir, so it never touches your
35	real setup):
36	
37	```bash
38	TMPD=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$TMPD/home"
39	chezmoi init --source="$PWD" --config="$TMPD/c.toml" --persistent-state="$TMPD/s.db" \
40	  --destination="$TMPD/home" --no-tty \
41	  --promptChoice='Role: workstation (full desktop) or minimal (shell only)=minimal' \
42	  --promptString='Your full name (git)=T' --promptString='Your git email=t@e.com' ...  # EVERY prompt, exact text
43	chezmoi apply --source="$PWD" --config="$TMPD/c.toml" --persistent-state="$TMPD/s.db" \
44	  --destination="$TMPD/home" --exclude=scripts   # scripts can't run off-Windows
45	chezmoi execute-template --config="$TMPD/c.toml" --source="$PWD" < some.ps1.tmpl > r.ps1  # then parse r.ps1 with pwsh
46	```
47	
48	## Architecture (big picture)
49	
50	- **Init** — `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl` `[data]` prompts once (`role` → coarse defaults, then `installX` toggles) and sets `[interpreters.ps1] = pwsh` so chezmoi runs `.ps1` scripts under pwsh. Prompts are hand-authored here (the parent repo generates them; this repo does not).
51	- **Shell** — `Documents/PowerShell/Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1` is a thin `$PROFILE` loader that dot-sources `dot_config/powershell/profile.d/*.ps1` in numeric order (env → tool activation → aliases → apps/audio/clipboard → copilot import → yazi → tv cache → psreadline). Add a shell feature = a new numbered fragment. User overrides go in the untracked `~/.config/powershell/local.ps1`.
52	- **Packages** — `.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_10_packages.ps1.tmpl` is the single source of truth for installs: scoop (CLI), winget (GUI), npm (AI agents), PSGallery (PSFzf / AudioDeviceCmdlets), all gated by init toggles. `.chezmoitemplates/package-sources.ps1` is the single source for registry environment variables used both by that installer and `profile.d/05_mirrors.ps1`: managed machines use company PyPI/npm pull-through feeds; otherwise the China-mirror toggle selects GFW mirrors. Fault-tolerant (see invariants).
53	- **copilot-proxy** — `dot_config/powershell/modules/Copilot/` is a native PowerShell port of the parent's `43_copilot_proxy.sh` / `44_copilot_embed.sh` (runs the copilot-api fork so GitHub Copilot can back Claude Code and Codex). Reuses the Bun `copilot-throttle-shim.js` verbatim.
54	- **Config surfaces** — Alacritty (`AppData/Roaming/alacritty/`), Windows Terminal (a run_onchange that merges `profiles.defaults` non-destructively), WezTerm (`dot_config/wezterm/wezterm.lua` — sets pwsh as `default_prog`), editors (a run_onchange that deep-merges `editors/*.json` into `%APPDATA%\{Code,Cursor}\User`), Claude Code (a run_onchange that recursively deep-merges `claude/settings-overlay.json` — claude-hud statusline, safe defaults, and **additive** `Notification`/`Stop` notify hooks — into `~/.claude/settings.json` non-destructively, gated on `installCodingAgents`), Codex (`dot_codex/modify_config.toml.ps1.tmpl` fail-closed-merges only the native `tui.status_line` into `~/.codex/config.toml`, preserving providers/projects/plugins and gated on `installCodingAgents`), apprise desktop notifications (`dot_config/apprise/apprise.yaml` → `~/.config/apprise/`; the `windows://` toast backend behind the Claude notify hook `dot_claude/hooks/notify.ps1`, `installCodingAgents`-gated — the notify hook and peon-ping's voice-line hooks are both gated on the `agentSounds` tier (none|notify|peon|both) and built in the run_onchange, NOT in `claude/settings-overlay.json`; see docs/agent-sounds.md), television channels (`AppData/Roaming/television/`), starship + yazi (`~/.config`, yazi via `YAZI_CONFIG_HOME`), Rime/Weasel (see below), herdr (see below).
55	- **Rime input method** — `installInputMethod`-gated, and the one config surface **shared with the parent repo**. The engine-level YAML lives in `.chezmoitemplates/rime/` (`default.custom.yaml`, `luna_pinyin.custom.yaml`) and is kept **byte-identical** to `daviddwlee84/dotfiles`'s copy of the same path — `diff -r` between the two dirs is the drift check, so edit one and copy to the other in the same session. Each platform is a one-line `{{ template "rime/…" . }}` renderer: `AppData/Roaming/Rime/` here, `private_Library/Rime/` (Squirrel) and `dot_config/ibus/rime/` (ibus-rime) there. Only `weasel.custom.yaml` is Windows-specific (`style/` is Weasel's own, `app_options` keys on the EXE name vs. Squirrel's bundle ids, and `global_ascii` doesn't exist on Squirrel). Plain managed files, **not** a `modify_` overlay: Rime persists runtime state to `user.yaml`, never back into `*.custom.yaml`. Two gotchas: a bare silent winget install registers **简体** (hence `--custom '/T'` in `Install-Weasel` — see `pitfalls/weasel-silent-install-registers-simplified-chinese.md`), and config edits need a redeploy, which `run_onchange_after_50_rime_deploy.ps1` does via `WeaselDeployer.exe /deploy`.
56	- **herdr** — `dot_config/herdr/` is deployed via `HERDR_CONFIG_PATH` and gated on `installHerdr`. `config.toml` is a **`modify_` overlay** (`modify_config.toml.ps1.tmpl` + `.chezmoitemplates/herdr/config.toml`), never a plain managed file: herdr rewrites that file at runtime (onboarding flag, `[session]`, `[remote]`, `[update]` bookkeeping) and a plain file clobbers it. The overlay enforces `[theme]`/`[ui]`/`[terminal]`/`[keys]` wholesale, pulls every other top-level key through, and re-asserts the single key `update.channel = "preview"` (the Windows installer rejects `stable`). Helper-script paths in the keymap are baked **absolute at render time** — `pwsh -File` does not expand `~`. Six pwsh helpers (`_common.ps1` + run-command / new-tab-at-space-root / url-pick / path-pick / pane-copy / review-mark) back the `[[keys.command]]` bindings; three `herdr-*` tv channels and the herdr-plus quick-actions are gated by the same toggle. Ported from the parent repo 2026-07-27; the behaviours that still need a real Windows box are listed in [`backlog/herdr-windows-port-verification.md`](backlog/herdr-windows-port-verification.md).
57	- **git config** — `~/.gitconfig` is a **`modify_` overlay** (`modify_dot_gitconfig.ps1.tmpl`), never a plain managed file: Git Credential Manager writes `[credential "azrepos:*"]` blocks into it out of band and a plain file would clobber them every apply. The baseline body is `.chezmoitemplates/git/gitconfig` (identity from the existing `.name`/`.email` init prompts); the merge engine is `scripts/gitconfig-merge.ps1`, inlined via `{{ include }}` (the `editors/` idiom) and dot-sourced by `tests/GitConfig.Tests.ps1`. The model is **key-level pull-through**: the baseline owns a fixed set of `section.key` pairs and every other live key is carried over untouched — the inverse of the parent repo's allowlist, which would silently drop `[otel]` and future corp sections. Two hard rules: `core.hooksPath` is **never** emitted (git honours it *instead of* `.git/hooks/`, silently disarming `pre-commit`), and the carry dictionary is **case-sensitive** (`[ordered]@{}` collapses `azrepos:org/O365Exchange` into `azrepos:org/o365exchange`, merging two credential contexts).
58	- **Docs** — bilingual mkdocs-material (`docs/X.md` + `docs/X.zh-TW.md`), deployed to GitHub Pages by `.github/workflows/docs.yml`. `docs/rationale.md` records the design choices (scoop > Chocolatey, starship > oh-my-posh, pwsh > cmd, native pwsh tree > ported shell layer).
59	- **CI** — `.github/workflows/windows.yml` on `windows-latest` is the real gate: PSScriptAnalyzer, non-interactive `chezmoi init --apply`, render+parse of every `.ps1.tmpl`, and Pester.
60	
61	## Conventions & hard invariants
62	
63	1. **A new/renamed init prompt must update the CI flags in the same commit.** `chezmoi init --promptBool/--promptChoice "<text>=value"` matches the prompt's exact TEXT (3rd arg to `promptXOnce` in `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl`), used non-interactively by `.github/workflows/windows.yml`. Forget it → CI's init hangs/EOFs (`error calling promptChoiceOnce: EOF`; this broke three consecutive pushes when `agentSounds` was added). Corollary: **never put `=` in a prompt's text** — the `name=value` parser splits on the first `=` (this broke the `role` prompt once). Enforced by `tests/InitPrompts.Tests.ps1` (missing flag, stale flag, wrong flag kind, `=` in text), which CI runs *before* `chezmoi init` so the failure names the missing flag instead of EOF-ing — run `Invoke-Pester -Path ./tests/InitPrompts.Tests.ps1` locally after touching either file.
64	2. **Run-scripts must never abort the apply.** The installer + editor/terminal/backup/skill scripts use `$ErrorActionPreference='Continue'` (+ `PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference=$false`), collect failures via `Register-Failure`, print a summary, and exit 0. One bad scoop/winget manifest (e.g. btop's stale `.conf`) must not stop the rest.
65	3. **Preserve raw escapes when authoring config with control chars.** Alacritty CSI-u (`[…u`), VSCode `sendSequence`, tv `\t` — hand-typing tends to drop them. Generate via a throwaway Python script and re-parse (`tomllib` / `json`) to confirm the escape landed.
66	4. **tv channel commands are `pwsh -NoProfile -Command "…"` inside TOML literal (`'''…'''`) strings** — runs regardless of tv's shell, sidesteps nested-quote escaping; placeholders `{split: :0}` (space) / `{split:\t:0}` (tab). tv reads config from `%APPDATA%\television\` on Windows.
67	5. **Editors use a run_onchange pwsh merger, not `modify_`** (`modify_` interpreter selection is unreliable on Windows). Overlay sources live in `editors/` (chezmoi-ignored, embedded via `{{ include }}`).
68	6. **The agent skill body lives once** in `.chezmoitemplates/dotfiles-windows-skill.md`; both `dot_agents/skills/dotfiles-windows/SKILL.md.tmpl` and `dot_claude/skills/dotfiles-windows/SKILL.md.tmpl` render it via `{{ "{{" }} template … {{ "}}" }}` → real files at `~/.agents/skills/` and `~/.claude/skills/`. Edit the shared template, not the two one-line renderers (no symlink/junction — those need elevation/Developer Mode on Windows).
69	7. **PSScriptAnalyzer exclusions are intentional** (`PSScriptAnalyzerSettings.psd1`): hyphenated command names, `Write-Host`, `Invoke-Expression` for tool init, no-BOM UTF-8. Don't "fix" these; do fix real Errors.
70	
71	### Cross-file mirrors (same commit)
72	
73	- New installer tool → `docs/tools.md` **and** `docs/tools.zh-TW.md`.
74	- New init prompt → `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl` + `windows.yml` flags + `docs/setup.md`/`setup.zh-TW.md` tables + the "What's enabled" block in `.chezmoitemplates/dotfiles-windows-skill.md`.
75	- New `docs/**/*.md` → its `.zh-TW.md` twin + `nav` + `nav_translations` in `mkdocs.yml`; `just docs-build` must stay green.
76	- Any edit under `.chezmoitemplates/rime/` → copy the file verbatim into the parent repo's `.chezmoitemplates/rime/` (`chezmoi source-path` there, usually `~/.local/share/chezmoi`). They must stay byte-identical; verify with `diff -r`. Frontend-only changes (`weasel.custom.yaml`) do **not** cross over.
77	- `core.autocrlf = input` has **two writers** — `bootstrap.ps1` (runs before chezmoi exists, so scoop's first bucket clone is protected) and `.chezmoitemplates/git/gitconfig` (the managed baseline). Change one → change the other.
78	
79	### `scripts/*.sh` are wrappers, not implementations
80	
81	`scripts/{add-todo,todo-kanban,promote-todo,sweep-inbox}.sh` are byte-identical
82	three-line shims. The real code is vendored at
83	`.agents/skills/project-knowledge-harness/scripts/<same-name>.sh`, and each
84	wrapper derives its target from `$0`, so adding a new helper only needs a copy
85	of an existing wrapper under the new name.
86	
87	They exist because the skill documents its helpers with cwd-relative paths
88	(`scripts/add-todo.sh`) and that prose was copied verbatim into the guidance
89	block below — where `scripts/` means *this* directory. Fixing the prose instead
90	would not survive, because `project-knowledge-harness` regenerates everything
91	between its sentinel markers. **This note is deliberately above the opening
92	sentinel so regeneration cannot erase it.**
93	
94	Not symlinks — invariant 6 (symlinks/junctions need elevation or Developer
95	Mode on Windows).
96	
97	<!-- project-knowledge-harness:agent-guidance -->
98	<!-- Snippet for the project's agent contract file (AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md /
99	     similar). The bundled scripts/init.sh appends this between sentinel
100	     markers; safe to re-run. -->
101	
102	### Long-term backlog → `TODO.md` + `backlog/`
103	
104	When the user surfaces an idea explicitly **not** being implemented this
105	session (signals: "maybe later", "nice to have", "if I'm interested",
106	"工程量太大需要再評估", "先記下來"), add an entry to [`TODO.md`](TODO.md) using
107	the priority + effort tag schema. Do **not** create new `ROADMAP.md` /
108	`IDEAS.md` / `BACKLOG.md` files — `TODO.md` is the single index.
109	
110	The bundled `scripts/todo-kanban.sh` validates the format. Run it
111	(`scripts/todo-kanban.sh --validate-only TODO.md`) after editing so syntax
112	drift is caught immediately.
113	
114	#### Three ways to add a TODO entry (preferred order)
115	
116	1. **Structured CLI — `scripts/add-todo.sh`** (default):
117	
118	   ```
119	   scripts/add-todo.sh --priority P3 --effort M \
120	     --title "Title" --description "Description"
121	   ```
122	
123	   Inserts a canonically-formatted line into the right `## P*` lane and
124	   re-runs the validator. Add `--backlog` to also scaffold
125	   `backlog/<slug>.md` from the bundled template.
126	
127	2. **Quick capture — `backlog/inbox.md`** (when priority/effort unclear):
128	
129	   ```
130	   echo "- maybe add docs versioning with mike" >> backlog/inbox.md
131	   ```
132	
133	   When the user asks "sweep the inbox", run
134	   `scripts/sweep-inbox.sh`. It prompts for the missing fields per loose
135	   line and calls `add-todo.sh`. Use `--batch` for non-interactive runs
136	   that only formalize lines with parseable `key=value` pairs.
137	
138	3. **Direct edit of `TODO.md`** — fine if the format is fresh; run
139	   `scripts/todo-kanban.sh --validate-only` afterwards.
140	
141	Add a `backlog/<slug>.md` companion doc when the item meets any of:
142	
143	- carries a `P?` tag (record what was tried so it doesn't need re-investigation)
144	- captures a paused troubleshooting session that you intend to fix later
145	  (preserve the error trace + root cause analysis before context evaporates)
146	- weighs multiple options (record trade-offs, not only the winner)
147	- is `[L]` or `[XL]` (architectural; needs design before code)
148	
149	`[S]` items rarely need a backlog doc — a file path in the `TODO.md` line is
150	usually enough. See [`backlog/README.md`](backlog/README.md) for the full
151	template and "when to add a doc" rules.
152	
153	When implementing a `TODO.md` item, in the same commit:
154	
155	1. Run `scripts/promote-todo.sh --title "<substring>" --summary "<what shipped>"`
156	   to move the entry into `## Done` with the dated syntax and re-validate.
157	2. Mark the corresponding `backlog/<slug>.md` (if any) `Status: shipped`
158	   and keep it as a historical record (don't delete — future-you may
159	   revisit adjacent decisions).
160	
161	`backlog/` is excluded from chezmoi (see .chezmoiignore); it
162	is repo metadata for maintainers, not user-facing config to deploy.
163	
164	### Past pitfalls → `pitfalls/`
165	
166	When you spend more than ~15 minutes debugging something that wasn't
167	googleable and the fix is non-obvious, write a `pitfalls/<slug>.md`
168	capturing:
169

2	# PowerShell port of the POSIX 43_copilot_proxy.sh / 44_copilot_embed.sh.

4	# Runs the maintained copilot-api fork (npm @jeffreycao/copilot-api) from a pinned
5	# local install so a GitHub Copilot subscription can back Claude Code and Codex.
6	# The optional Bun throttle shim (copilot-throttle-shim.js) is reused verbatim from
7	# the unix side.
8	#
9	# Public commands (exported with their original hyphenated names for muscle
10	# memory — PSUseApprovedVerbs is intentionally waived):
11	#   copilot-proxy [start|stop|restart|status|doctor [--live]|logs [shim|N]|shim [on|off|status]|whoami|auth|reinstall]
12	#   copilot-run <cmd...>            run a command with the proxy env injected
13	#   claude-copilot [args...]        one-off Claude Code session on the proxy
14	#   claude-copilot-once [args...]   pinned one-shot session, auto-reverted
15	#   codex-copilot [args...]         one-off Codex session on Responses proxy
16	#   codex-copilot-once [args...]    identical zero-persistence alias
17	# (claude-copilot / -once run claude with --dangerously-skip-permissions — the
18	#  proxy flow is the trusted, hands-off path; plain `claude` is unaffected.)
19	#   copilot-here [on|off|status]    per-project pin via ./.claude/settings.local.json
20	#   copilot-model [<id>|-l|-c|--auto]  switch the pinned model
21	#   copilot-embed [--model M] [--json] [TEXT|-] | -l
22	#   semsearch index [PATH...] | semsearch <QUERY> [-k N] [--corpus PATH]
23	#
24	# Contract preserved from the unix version: token at
25	# ~/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token, ports 4141 (proxy) / 4142 (shim),
26	# state under $XDG_STATE_HOME/copilot-proxy, per-project ./.claude/settings.local.json
27	# pin, default model gpt-5.6-sol[1m], and the ANTHROPIC_* env block.
28	#
29	# The pinned package is INSTALLED ONCE into $XDG_DATA_HOME/copilot-api/pkg and the
30	# proxy runs that binary directly. It deliberately does NOT use `bunx` at launch:
31	# bunx re-resolves the package on every start, and bun stalls forever resolving
32	# through a socks proxy — which wedged `start` at "Resolving dependencies" AND kept
33	# bun's global cache lock, so every retry hung too. Force a re-install with
34	# `copilot-proxy reinstall`.
35	#
36	# Env knobs:
37	#   COPILOT_PROXY_PORT   default 4141    - port the proxy listens on
38	#   COPILOT_PROXY_START_TIMEOUT default 45 - seconds allowed for model refresh
39	#   COPILOT_SHIM_PORT    default 4142    - throttle shim port
40	#   COPILOT_API_PKG      default @jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0 - registry spec

42	#                           aliases/local/git/URL specs are rejected before cleanup)
43	#   COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL                 - override the pinned model

73	# --- pinned package install (run the binary, never `bunx` at launch) -----------
74	#
75	# Why an install prefix instead of `bunx <pkg> start`: bunx re-resolves the
76	# package on EVERY launch, and bun hangs indefinitely resolving through a socks
77	# proxy (a browser/curl through the same proxy is fine, which is what makes it so
78	# confusing). The wedged installer then keeps bun's global install-cache lock, so
79	# every retry hangs identically and stacks another zombie. Installing once and
80	# running the resulting binary removes the per-start resolve entirely — a warm
81	# start does zero network before it binds the port.

83	# Parse only registry package specs: name or @scope/name, optionally followed by
84	# a version/tag/range. npm aliases and local/git/URL selectors are rejected before
85	# their text can reach any filesystem path or destructive cleanup.
86	function script:Get-CopilotPkgSpecInfo {
87	    $spec = Get-CopilotPkg
88	    $match = [regex]::Match(
89	        $spec,
90	        '^(?<name>@[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*|[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*)(?:@(?<selector>.+))?$'
91	    )
92	    if (-not $match.Success) { return $null }
93	    $selector = [string]$match.Groups['selector'].Value
94	    if ($selector -and (
95	        $selector -match '^(?:npm:|file:|link:|https?:|git(?:\+[^:]*)?:|github:|gitlab:|bitbucket:)' -or
96	        $selector -match '[\\/]'
97	    )) { return $null }
98	    [pscustomobject]@{
99	        Name     = [string]$match.Groups['name'].Value
100	        Selector = $selector
101	    }
102	}

301	# One package-install attempt in -Dir, bounded by -BudgetSeconds. npm is preferred
302	# because it supports Azure Artifacts' credential-provider token in ~/.npmrc;
303	# Bun does not. -NoProxy strips the proxy env for the child. Returns $true only
304	# when matching metadata and a runnable launch path exist afterwards.

306	# Success is judged from the FILESYSTEM, not $p.ExitCode: a Start-Process -PassThru
307	# object reports ExitCode 0 even for a child that exited non-zero (verified — the
308	# .Handle-caching workaround does not help either), so trusting it would let a
309	# failed install write the .installed-spec stamp and silently pin a broken prefix.
310	#
311	# The kill on expiry is the load-bearing part: a stalled `bun add` left running
312	# keeps bun's global install-cache lock, and THAT is what made every subsequent
313	# start hang too. Never let one escape.
314	function script:Invoke-CopilotPkgInstallTry {
315	    param([string] $Dir, [switch] $NoProxy, [int] $BudgetSeconds)
316	
317	    if (-not (Clear-CopilotPkgInstallTarget)) { return $false }
318	    $proxyVars = 'ALL_PROXY', 'all_proxy', 'HTTP_PROXY', 'http_proxy', 'HTTPS_PROXY', 'https_proxy'
319	    $npm = Get-Command npm.cmd -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
320	    $installer = if ($npm) {
321	        @{ File = $npm.Source; Args = @('install', '--no-save', '--no-audit', '--no-fund', (Get-CopilotPkg)) }
322	    } else {
323	        Write-Warning 'copilot-proxy: npm.cmd not found; falling back to Bun (authenticated Azure Artifacts feeds require npm).'
324	        @{ File = 'bun'; Args = @('add', (Get-CopilotPkg), '--no-summary') }
325	    }
326	    $saved = @{}
327	    if ($NoProxy) {
328	        foreach ($v in $proxyVars) { $saved[$v] = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($v); Remove-Item "env:$v" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
329	    }
330	    try {
331	        $p = Start-Process -FilePath $installer.File -ArgumentList $installer.Args `
332	            -WorkingDirectory $Dir -PassThru -NoNewWindow -ErrorAction Stop
333	        if ($p.WaitForExit($BudgetSeconds * 1000)) { return (Test-CopilotPkgInstalled) }
334	        Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
335	        # The subshell's child is the one actually holding the install lock.
336	        $name = [regex]::Escape((Get-CopilotPkgName))

338	            Where-Object { $_.Name -in 'bun.exe', 'node.exe' -and $_.CommandLine -match '\b(add|install)\b' -and $_.CommandLine -match $name } |
339	            ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
340	        return $false
341	    } catch {
342	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: could not launch package installer ($_)"; return $false
343	    } finally {
344	        if ($NoProxy) {
345	            foreach ($v in $proxyVars) {
346	                if ($null -eq $saved[$v]) { Remove-Item "env:$v" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
347	                else { Set-Item "env:$v" $saved[$v] }
348	            }
349	        }
350	    }
351	}

382	function script:Get-CopilotSha256Base64 {
383	    param([Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Path)
384	    $stream = [System.IO.File]::OpenRead($Path)
385	    try {
386	        $sha = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
387	        try { [Convert]::ToBase64String($sha.ComputeHash($stream)) } finally { $sha.Dispose() }
388	    } finally { $stream.Dispose() }
389	}

391	function script:Install-CopilotPkgDependencies {
392	    param([Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $PackageDir, [int] $BudgetSeconds = 120)
393	    $npm = Get-Command npm.cmd -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
394	    if (-not $npm) {
395	        Write-Error 'copilot-proxy: npm.cmd is required to install CDN package dependencies through the configured registry'
396	        return $false
397	    }
398	    try {
399	        $npmArgs = @('install', '--omit=dev', '--ignore-scripts', '--no-save', '--package-lock=false', '--no-audit', '--no-fund')
400	        $p = Start-Process -FilePath $npm.Source -ArgumentList $npmArgs -WorkingDirectory $PackageDir -PassThru -NoNewWindow -ErrorAction Stop
401	        if (-not $p.WaitForExit($BudgetSeconds * 1000)) {
402	            Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
403	            return $false
404	        }
405	        return (Test-CopilotPkgDependencies)
406	    } catch {
407	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: could not install CDN package dependencies ($_)"
408	        return $false
409	    }
410	}

412	function script:Install-CopilotPkgFromCdn {
413	    $manifest = Get-CopilotPkgCdnManifest
414	    if (-not $manifest) { return $false }
415	    if (-not (Clear-CopilotPkgInstallTarget)) { return $false }
416	
417	    $packageDir = Join-Path (Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) 'node_modules/@jeffreycao/copilot-api'
418	    $downloadDir = Join-Path (Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) ".cdn-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
419	    try {
420	        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $downloadDir | Out-Null
421	        foreach ($relativePath in $manifest.Files.Keys) {
422	            $downloadPath = Join-Path $downloadDir ($relativePath -replace '/', [System.IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar)
423	            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path -Parent $downloadPath) | Out-Null
424	            Invoke-WebRequest -Uri ($manifest.BaseUrl + $relativePath) -OutFile $downloadPath -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30 -ErrorAction Stop
425	            $actualHash = Get-CopilotSha256Base64 -Path $downloadPath
426	            if ($actualHash -cne $manifest.Files[$relativePath]) {
427	                throw "hash mismatch for $relativePath"
428	            }
429	        }
430	
431	        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path -Parent $packageDir) | Out-Null
432	        Move-Item -LiteralPath $downloadDir -Destination $packageDir -ErrorAction Stop
433	        $metadata = Get-CopilotPkgMetadata
434	        if (-not $metadata -or $metadata.Name -cne '@jeffreycao/copilot-api' -or $metadata.Version -cne '2.1.0') {
435	            throw 'downloaded package metadata does not identify @jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0'
436	        }
437	        if (-not (Install-CopilotPkgDependencies -PackageDir $packageDir)) {
438	            throw 'dependency installation through the configured registry failed'
439	        }
440	        return (Test-CopilotPkgInstalled)
441	    } catch {
442	        Write-Warning "copilot-proxy: pinned CDN fallback failed ($_)"
443	        $null = Clear-CopilotPkgInstallTarget
444	        return $false
445	    } finally {
446	        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $downloadDir -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
447	    }
448	}

450	# Ensure the pinned spec is installed. No-op (and no network) once it is.
451	function script:Install-CopilotPkg {
452	    if (-not (Get-CopilotPkgSpecInfo)) {
453	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: COPILOT_API_PKG must be a registry package spec (name or @scope/name with an optional version/tag/range); aliases and local/git/URL specs are unsupported: $(Get-CopilotPkg)"
454	        return $false
455	    }
456	    if (Test-CopilotPkgReady) { return $true }
457	
458	    # Migrate the old one-line stamp without a network call only when an exact
459	    # selector, the legacy stamp, live package metadata and launch path all agree.
460	    $metadata = Get-CopilotPkgMetadata
461	    if ((Get-CopilotPkgExactVersion) -and
462	        (Get-CopilotPkgLegacyStamp) -ceq (Get-CopilotPkg) -and
463	        (Test-CopilotPkgInstalled -Metadata $metadata)) {
464	        Write-CopilotPkgStamp -Metadata $metadata
465	        return $true
466	    }
467	
468	    if (-not (Get-Command bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
469	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: bun not found (scoop install bun)"; return $false
470	    }
471	    $spec = Get-CopilotPkg; $prefix = Get-CopilotPkgPrefix
472	    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $prefix | Out-Null
473	    # A private package.json keeps `bun add` from walking up and polluting $HOME.
474	    $pkgJson = Join-Path $prefix 'package.json'
475	    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $pkgJson)) {
476	        '{"name":"copilot-api-runner","private":true,"version":"0.0.0"}' | Set-Content -Path $pkgJson -Encoding utf8
477	    }
478	
479	    Write-Host "copilot-proxy: installing $spec (one-time — later starts skip this) ..."
480	    # Attempt 1 honours the ambient env: on a host where the npm registry is only
481	    # reachable THROUGH the proxy, stripping it would break the install. Attempt 2
482	    # strips it, which is what rescues the socks stall. COPILOT_INSTALL_NOPROXY=1
483	    # skips straight to attempt 2 (saves the 45s stall on a known-bad host).
484	    $skipFirst = ($env:COPILOT_INSTALL_NOPROXY -eq '1')
485	    if ($skipFirst -or -not (Invoke-CopilotPkgInstallTry -Dir $prefix -BudgetSeconds 45)) {
486	        if (-not $skipFirst) {
487	            Write-Warning "copilot-proxy: install failed or stalled with the proxy env — retrying without it ..."
488	            # Drop bun's cache lock dir before retrying; the killed attempt may have
489	            # left it behind, and a stale lock hangs the retry for the same reason.
490	            $bunHome = if ($env:BUN_INSTALL) { $env:BUN_INSTALL } else { Join-Path $HOME '.bun' }
491	            Remove-Item -Recurse -Force (Join-Path $bunHome 'install/cache/.tmp') -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
492	        }
493	        if (-not (Invoke-CopilotPkgInstallTry -Dir $prefix -NoProxy -BudgetSeconds 90)) {
494	            Write-Warning 'copilot-proxy: configured npm registry did not provide the pin — trying the hash-pinned jsDelivr package copy; dependencies still use the configured registry ...'
495	            if (-not (Install-CopilotPkgFromCdn)) {
496	                Write-Error "copilot-proxy: could not install $spec from the configured registry or pinned CDN fallback — run 'copilot-proxy doctor'."; return $false
497	            }
498	        }
499	    }
500	
501	    $metadata = Get-CopilotPkgMetadata
502	    if (-not (Test-CopilotPkgInstalled -Metadata $metadata)) {
503	        $actual = if ($metadata) { "$($metadata.Name)@$($metadata.Version)" } else { 'no readable package metadata' }
504	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: install finished but $actual does not satisfy $spec with a runnable launch path under $prefix."
505	        return $false
506	    }
507	    Write-CopilotPkgStamp -Metadata $metadata
508	    $true
509	}

511	# Run a copilot-api subcommand (auth / check-usage / debug) in the foreground.
512	# Honours $launch.Cwd so the `bun run` fallback resolves node_modules/.bin.
513	function script:Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand {
514	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argument)
515	    if (-not (Install-CopilotPkg)) {
516	        $global:LASTEXITCODE = 1
517	        throw 'copilot-proxy: package installation or verification failed'
518	    }
519	    $launch = Get-CopilotPkgLaunch
520	    if (-not $launch) {
521	        $global:LASTEXITCODE = 1
522	        throw "copilot-proxy: no runnable copilot-api — try 'copilot-proxy reinstall'"
523	    }
524	    if ($launch.Cwd) { Push-Location $launch.Cwd }
525	    try {
526	        & $launch.Exe @($launch.Pre + $Argument)
527	        $commandExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
528	        $global:LASTEXITCODE = $commandExitCode
529	        if ($commandExitCode -ne 0) {
530	            throw "copilot-proxy: copilot-api $($Argument -join ' ') failed with exit code $commandExitCode"
531	        }
532	    } finally { if ($launch.Cwd) { Pop-Location } }
533	}

535	# Live `bun add … copilot-api` processes. Install is a one-shot, so a match at
536	# rest is a clean stale-installer signal: a stalled one keeps bun's global
537	# install-cache lock, which wedges every later install too. Invoke-CopilotPkgInstallTry
538	# bounds and kills its own attempts, so this should stay empty — it remains as a
539	# safety net for a stall we didn't spawn (e.g. a hand-run `bunx @jeffreycao/copilot-api`).
540	function script:Get-CopilotStaleInstaller {
541	    Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'bun.exe'" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
542	        Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match '\badd\b' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'copilot-api' }
543	}

555	# --- egress: which proxy should Node use for the GitHub /models fetch? --------
556	#
557	# copilot-api fetches /models at startup and refreshes its cache periodically;
558	# restart forces an immediate refresh. GitHub geo-filters the Claude catalog on
559	# some egress paths. Node does NOT honour the Windows System Proxy on its own — it
560	# only sees HTTP(S)_PROXY — so a host whose browser reaches the unfiltered catalog
561	# could still have the proxy cache a Claude-less list, which then looks exactly
562	# like an entitlement problem. Resolve the URL here and hand it to the child.
563	#
564	# COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY: auto|always|never|<url>. Returns a URL or $null.
565	function script:Resolve-CopilotHttpProxy {
566	    $mode = if ($env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY) { $env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY } else { 'auto' }
567	    switch -Regex ($mode) {
568	        '^(never|off|0|false|no)$' { return $null }
569	        '^(http|https|socks5h?)://' { return $mode }
570	        '^(always|auto|on|1|true|yes)$' { break }
571	        default {
572	            Write-Warning "copilot-proxy: unknown COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY='$mode' (use auto|always|never|http://...)"
573	            return $null
574	        }
575	    }
576	
577	    # The Windows System Proxy (WinINET). This is what Clash Verge / mihomo /
578	    # v2rayN write when their "System Proxy" toggle is on, so reading it covers
579	    # the same ground the unix side gets from its Clash detector.
580	    try {
581	        $key = Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Internet Settings' -ErrorAction Stop
582	        if ($key.ProxyEnable -eq 1 -and $key.ProxyServer) {
583	            # ProxyServer is either "host:port" or "http=host:port;https=host:port".
584	            $server = $key.ProxyServer
585	            if ($server -match '(?:^|;)\s*https?=([^;]+)') { $server = $Matches[1] }
586	            elseif ($server -match ';') { $server = ($server -split ';')[0] }
587	            if ($server) { return "http://$($server -replace '^https?://', '')" }
588	        }
589	    } catch { $null = $_ }
590	
591	    # Fallback: an explicit env proxy in this shell.
592	    foreach ($v in $env:HTTPS_PROXY, $env:https_proxy, $env:HTTP_PROXY, $env:http_proxy) {
593	        if ($v) { return $v }
594	    }
595	    $null
596	}
597	
598	# Model ids GitHub serves for this account RIGHT NOW, for the direct-vs-proxied
599	# A/B in doctor. -Via: 'direct' forces no proxy, a URL forces that proxy, absent
600	# uses .NET defaults. Returns sorted-unique ids, or $null on any failure.
601	#
602	# Secrets: the ghu_/bearer tokens only ever travel in request headers — never in
603	# a command line, never echoed.
604	function script:Get-CopilotUpstreamModel {
605	    param([string] $Via)
606	
607	    $tokFile = Get-CopilotToken
608	    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $tokFile)) { return $null }
609	    $ghu = Get-Content -First 1 $tokFile -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
610	    if (-not $ghu) { return $null }
611	
612	    $transport = @{}
613	    if ($Via -eq 'direct') { $transport['NoProxy'] = $true }
614	    elseif ($Via) { $transport['Proxy'] = $Via }
615	
616	    try {
617	        $ex = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'https://api.github.com/copilot_internal/v2/token' -TimeoutSec 10 `
618	            -Headers @{ 'Authorization' = "token $ghu"; 'user-agent' = 'GitHubCopilotChat/0.26.7' } `
619	            @transport -ErrorAction Stop
620	    } catch { return $null }
621	
622	    $api = if ($ex.endpoints.api) { $ex.endpoints.api } else { 'https://api.githubcopilot.com' }
623	    if (-not $ex.token) { return $null }
624	
625	    try {
626	        $up = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$api/models" -TimeoutSec 12 `
627	            -Headers @{
628	                'Authorization'            = "Bearer $($ex.token)"
629	                'user-agent'               = 'GitHubCopilotChat/0.26.7'
630	                'copilot-integration-id'   = 'vscode-chat'
631	            } @transport -ErrorAction Stop
632	    } catch { return $null }
633	
634	    @($up.data.id | Where-Object { $_ } | Sort-Object -Unique)
635	}

637	# Optional ChatGPT Apps reachability. This is deliberately separate from the
638	# Copilot inference probes: codex_apps is a remote MCP served by chatgpt.com,
639	# not a localhost bridge to Codex.app and not part of GitHub Copilot.
640	function script:Get-CopilotProbeFailureKind {
641	    param($ErrorRecord)
642	
643	    $message = if ($ErrorRecord -is [System.Management.Automation.ErrorRecord]) {
644	        $ErrorRecord.Exception.ToString()
645	    } else { [string]$ErrorRecord }
646	
647	    if ($message -match '(?i)timed?\s*out|timeout|operation.*canceled|deadline') { return 'timeout' }
648	    if ($message -match '(?i)certificate|authenticationexception|ssl|tls|secure channel') { return 'tls' }
649	    'network'
650	}

652	function script:Invoke-CopilotOptionalHttpProbe {
653	    param(
654	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Uri,
655	        [string] $Via = 'direct'
656	    )
657	
658	    $transport = @{}
659	    if ($Via -eq 'direct') { $transport['NoProxy'] = $true }
660	    elseif ($Via) { $transport['Proxy'] = $Via }
661	
662	    $sw = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
663	    try {
664	        $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $Uri -Method Get -TimeoutSec 12 `
665	            -SkipHttpErrorCheck -Headers @{ 'user-agent' = 'codex-copilot-doctor/1.0' } `
666	            @transport -ErrorAction Stop
667	        $sw.Stop()
668	        [pscustomobject]@{
669	            Reached = $true
670	            Code    = [int]$response.StatusCode
671	            Seconds = [math]::Round($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds, 2)
672	            Kind    = $null
673	            Error   = $null
674	        }
675	    } catch {
676	        $sw.Stop()
677	        [pscustomobject]@{
678	            Reached = $false
679	            Code    = 0
680	            Seconds = [math]::Round($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds, 2)
681	            Kind    = Get-CopilotProbeFailureKind $_
682	            Error   = ($_.Exception.Message -replace '\s+', ' ').Trim()
683	        }
684	    }
685	}

711	# Resolve the model: $COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL > state file > default.
712	#
713	#   - HYPHENATED ids (claude-opus-4-8), not dotted (claude-opus-4.8): Claude Code
714	#     only recognizes hyphenated family names — dotted ids fall back to a legacy
715	#     "[Opus 4] retired" label AND a 200k context assumption.
716	#   - "[1m]" suffix: Claude Code uses it to size HUD/compaction for a 1M context
717	#     window. ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel derives it from live /v1/models metadata
718	#     for every provider. Claude Code-only: raw API clients use the plain id.
719	function script:Get-CopilotDefaultModel {
720	    if ($env:COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL) { return $env:COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL }
721	    $sf = Get-CopilotModelState
722	    if (Test-Path $sf) { return (Get-Content -First 1 $sf) }
723	    'gpt-5.6-sol[1m]'
724	}

726	# Every model id the proxy accepts: .id plus the .claude_model_id alias. Callers
727	# with several catalog views pass one snapshot so all decisions share one response.
728	function script:Get-CopilotServedModels {
729	    param($Catalog)
730	    if (-not $PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('Catalog')) { $Catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog }
731	    if (-not $Catalog) { return @() }
732	    $ids = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
733	    foreach ($m in $Catalog.data) {
734	        if ($m.id) { $ids.Add([string]$m.id) }
735	        if ($m.claude_model_id) { $ids.Add([string]$m.claude_model_id) }
736	    }
737	    $ids | Sort-Object -Unique
738	}

758	# Pick exactly one live inference target. The configured main wins only when its
759	# raw id is advertised; otherwise the catalog-ranked fallback is explicit.
760	function script:Resolve-CopilotDoctorTarget {
761	    param([string] $ConfiguredMain, [string[]] $RawModel)
762	    $RawModel = @($RawModel | Where-Object { $_ -and $_ -notmatch 'embedding' } | Sort-Object -Unique)
763	    $rawConfigured = Remove-CopilotContextHint $ConfiguredMain
764	    if (-not $rawConfigured) {
765	        return [pscustomobject]@{
766	            Model  = $null
767	            Label  = 'MissingConfiguredMain'
768	            Reason = 'the active project proxy pin has no ANTHROPIC_MODEL'
769	        }
770	    }
771	    if ($RawModel -contains $rawConfigured) {
772	        return [pscustomobject]@{
773	            Model  = $rawConfigured
774	            Label  = 'ConfiguredMain'
775	            Reason = 'configured main is advertised by the live catalog'
776	        }
777	    }
778	
779	    $fallback = Select-CopilotBestModel -Model $RawModel
780	    [pscustomobject]@{
781	        Model  = $fallback
782	        Label  = 'CatalogFallback'
783	        Reason = "configured main '$rawConfigured' is not advertised by the live catalog"
784	    }
785	}

787	function script:ConvertTo-CopilotCompactText {
788	    param($Value, [int] $MaxLength = 320)
789	    $text = if ($Value -is [string]) { $Value } else {
790	        try { $Value | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 12 -Compress -ErrorAction Stop } catch { [string]$Value }
791	    }
792	    $text = ($text -replace '\s+', ' ').Trim()
793	    if ($text.Length -gt $MaxLength) { return $text.Substring(0, $MaxLength - 3) + '...' }
794	    $text
795	}
796	
797	# Error bodies appear as direct code/message pairs, error.code/error.message, or
798	# another JSON error encoded inside error.message. Normalize all three shapes.
799	function script:Get-CopilotApiError {
800	    param($Body, [int] $Depth = 0)
801	    $raw = ConvertTo-CopilotCompactText $Body
802	    if ($Depth -gt 4) {
803	        return [pscustomobject]@{ Code = $null; Message = $null; Raw = $raw }
804	    }
805	
806	    $object = $Body
807	    if ($Body -is [string]) {
808	        try { $object = $Body | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop }
809	        catch { return [pscustomobject]@{ Code = $null; Message = $null; Raw = $raw } }
810	    }
811	    if (-not $object) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Code = $null; Message = $null; Raw = $raw } }
812	
813	    $container = $object
814	    if ($object.PSObject.Properties['error']) {
815	        $container = $object.error
816	        if ($container -is [string]) {
817	            $nestedError = Get-CopilotApiError -Body $container -Depth ($Depth + 1)
818	            if ($nestedError.Code -or $nestedError.Message) { return $nestedError }
819	        }
820	    }
821	
822	    $code = if ($container.PSObject.Properties['code']) { [string]$container.code } else { $null }
823	    $message = if ($container.PSObject.Properties['message']) { [string]$container.message } else { $null }
824	    if ($message -and $message.TrimStart().StartsWith('{')) {
825	        $nestedMessage = Get-CopilotApiError -Body $message -Depth ($Depth + 1)
826	        if ($nestedMessage.Code -or $nestedMessage.Message) {
827	            return [pscustomobject]@{
828	                Code    = if ($nestedMessage.Code) { $nestedMessage.Code } else { $code }
829	                Message = if ($nestedMessage.Message) { $nestedMessage.Message } else { $message }
830	                Raw     = $raw
831	            }
832	        }
833	    }
834	    [pscustomobject]@{ Code = $code; Message = $message; Raw = $raw }
835	}

837	function script:Classify-CopilotInferenceError {
838	    param([int] $StatusCode, $Body)
839	    $errorInfo = Get-CopilotApiError -Body $Body
840	    $code = ([string]$errorInfo.Code).ToLowerInvariant()
841	    $detailParts = @($errorInfo.Code, $errorInfo.Message) | Where-Object { $_ }
842	    $detail = $detailParts -join ': '
843	    if (-not $detail) { $detail = $errorInfo.Raw }
844	
845	    if ($StatusCode -eq 402 -and $code -eq 'billing_not_configured') {
846	        return [pscustomobject]@{
847	            Kind        = 'BillingNotConfigured'
848	            Code        = $errorInfo.Code
849	            Message     = $errorInfo.Message
850	            Summary     = "account-wide GitHub Copilot billing is not configured: $detail"
851	            Retryable   = $false
852	            AccountWide = $true
853	            Action      = 'https://github.com/settings/copilot/features'
854	            Guidance    = 'Select an organization or enterprise in GitHub''s "Usage billed to" setting. Changing the model, using --auto, or enabling the shim cannot fix this account-wide failure.'
855	        }
856	    }
857	
858	    if ($code -match '^(model_not_supported|model_unsupported|unsupported_model)$') {
859	        return [pscustomobject]@{
860	            Kind        = 'ModelUnsupported'
861	            Code        = $errorInfo.Code
862	            Message     = $errorInfo.Message
863	            Summary     = $detail
864	            Retryable   = $false
865	            AccountWide = $false
866	            Action      = 'Run copilot-model --auto, or copilot-model -l and select a model advertised by the live catalog.'
867	            Guidance    = $null
868	        }
869	    }
870	
871	    [pscustomobject]@{
872	        Kind        = 'HttpError'
873	        Code        = $errorInfo.Code
874	        Message     = $errorInfo.Message
875	        Summary     = $detail
876	        Retryable   = ($StatusCode -eq 429 -or $StatusCode -ge 500)
877	        AccountWide = $false
878	        Action      = $null
879	        Guidance    = $null
880	    }
881	}

883	# Convert a raw proxy id to the spelling Claude Code should receive. A live
884	# max_context_window_tokens >= 1M earns [1m]. Offline, preserve an explicitly
885	# stored suffix but do not invent one.
886	function script:ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel {
887	    param([Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Model, $Catalog)
888	    $hadHint = $Model -match '\[1m\]$'
889	    $raw = Remove-CopilotContextHint $Model
890	    if (-not $PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('Catalog')) { $Catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog }
891	    if ($Catalog) {
892	        $entry = $Catalog.data | Where-Object { $_.id -eq $raw } | Select-Object -First 1
893	        $context = $entry.capabilities.limits.max_context_window_tokens
894	        if ($context -and [long]$context -ge 1000000) { return "$raw[1m]" }
895	        return $raw
896	    }
897	    if ($hadHint) { return "$raw[1m]" }
898	    $raw
899	}

904	    $null
