```text
106	# ALL_PROXY (curl through the same proxy is fine, which is what makes it so
107	# confusing). The wedged installer then keeps bun's global cache lock, so every
108	# retry hangs identically and stacks another zombie. Installing once and exec'ing
109	# the resulting binary removes the per-start resolve entirely — a warm start does
110	# zero network before it binds the port. Full story:
111	# pitfalls/copilot-proxy-start-hangs-at-resolving-dependencies.md
112	
113	# Package NAME without the trailing @version, keeping any @scope/ prefix.
114	# The naive "${spec%@*}" eats the whole string on a scoped spec with no version
115	# (@jeffreycao/copilot-api -> ""), so test on the scope-stripped copy.
116	_copilot_pkg_name() {
117	  local spec base
118	  spec="$(_copilot_pkg)"
119	  base="${spec#@}"
120	  case "$base" in
121	    *@*) printf '%s' "${spec%@*}" ;;
122	    *)   printf '%s' "$spec" ;;
123	  esac
124	}
125	
126	_copilot_pkg_prefix() { printf '%s' "${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/copilot-api/pkg"; }
127	_copilot_pkg_bin()    { printf '%s' "$(_copilot_pkg_prefix)/node_modules/.bin/copilot-api"; }
128	# Records the spec the prefix currently holds, so bumping COPILOT_API_PKG (or the
129	# pinned default) re-installs instead of silently running the old version.
130	_copilot_pkg_stamp()  { printf '%s' "$(_copilot_pkg_prefix)/.installed-spec"; }
131	
132	# Is the CURRENTLY pinned spec installed and runnable?
133	_copilot_pkg_ready() {
134	  local bin stamp
135	  bin="$(_copilot_pkg_bin)"; stamp="$(_copilot_pkg_stamp)"
136	  [ -x "$bin" ] || return 1
137	  [ -f "$stamp" ] || return 1
138	  [ "$(command head -n 1 "$stamp" 2>/dev/null)" = "$(_copilot_pkg)" ]
139	}
140	
141	# One package-install attempt in $1. $2 = "noproxy" strips the proxy env,
142	# "npm" uses npm without proxy env (a useful fallback when Bun rejects a TUN /
143	# MITM certificate chain), and anything else runs Bun with the ambient env.
144	# $3 = seconds budget, enforced by polling — `timeout(1)` is not in macOS base,
145	# and this file is sourced by both shells. Returns 124 on expiry.
146	#
147	# The kill on expiry is the load-bearing part: a stalled `bun add` left running
148	# keeps bun's global install-cache lock, and THAT is what made every subsequent
149	# start hang too. Never let one escape.
150	_copilot_pkg_install_try() {
151	  local dir="$1" mode="$2" budget="$3" pkg pid i=0 log
152	  pkg="$(_copilot_pkg)"
153	  log="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copilot-pkg-install-$$.log"
154	  if [ "$mode" = "noproxy" ]; then
155	    ( cd "$dir" 2>/dev/null && command env \
156	        -u ALL_PROXY -u all_proxy -u HTTP_PROXY -u http_proxy \
157	        -u HTTPS_PROXY -u https_proxy \
158	        bun add "$pkg" --no-summary >"$log" 2>&1 ) &
159	  elif [ "$mode" = "npm" ]; then
160	    ( cd "$dir" 2>/dev/null && command env \
161	        -u ALL_PROXY -u all_proxy -u HTTP_PROXY -u http_proxy \
162	        -u HTTPS_PROXY -u https_proxy \
163	        npm install --no-audit --no-fund --save-exact "$pkg" >"$log" 2>&1 ) &
164	  else
165	    ( cd "$dir" 2>/dev/null && command bun add "$pkg" --no-summary >"$log" 2>&1 ) &
166	  fi
167	  pid=$!
168	  while [ "$i" -lt "$budget" ]; do
169	    if ! kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
170	      wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null
171	      local rc=$?
172	      if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] && [ -s "$log" ]; then
173	        command tail -n 3 "$log" >&2
174	      fi
175	      command rm -f -- "$log"
176	      return "$rc"
177	    fi
178	    sleep 1
179	    i=$((i + 1))
180	  done
181	  # Braces + 2>/dev/null swallow the shell's own async "Killed" job notification:
182	  # we report the timeout ourselves, and a raw job-control message here reads like
183	  # a crash. Kill the whole process group's `bun add` too — the subshell's child
184	  # is the one actually holding the cache lock.
185	  { kill -9 "$pid" 2>/dev/null
186	    command pkill -9 -f "bun add.*$(_copilot_pkg_name)" 2>/dev/null
187	    command pkill -9 -f "npm install.*$(_copilot_pkg_name)" 2>/dev/null
188	    wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null
189	  } 2>/dev/null
190	  command rm -f -- "$log"
191	  return 124
192	}
193	
194	# Ensure the pinned spec is installed. No-op (and no network) once it is.
195	_copilot_ensure_pkg() {
196	  local spec prefix bin
197	  spec="$(_copilot_pkg)"; prefix="$(_copilot_pkg_prefix)"; bin="$(_copilot_pkg_bin)"
198	
199	  _copilot_pkg_ready && return 0
200	
201	  if ! command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then
202	    printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: bun not found (needs bun via mise)." >&2
203	    return 1
204	  fi
205	  command mkdir -p "$prefix" || return 1
206	  # A private package.json keeps `bun add` from walking up and polluting $HOME.
207	  [ -f "$prefix/package.json" ] || printf '%s\n' \
208	    '{"name":"copilot-api-runner","private":true,"version":"0.0.0"}' >"$prefix/package.json"
209	
210	  printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: installing $spec (one-time — later starts skip this) ..."
211	  # Attempt 1 honours the ambient env: on a host where the npm registry is only
212	  # reachable THROUGH the proxy, stripping it would break the install. Attempt 2
213	  # strips it, which is what rescues the socks stall. COPILOT_INSTALL_NOPROXY=1
214	  # skips straight to attempt 2 (saves the 45s stall on a known-bad host).
215	  if [ "${COPILOT_INSTALL_NOPROXY:-0}" = "1" ] \
216	     || ! _copilot_pkg_install_try "$prefix" env 45; then
217	    if [ "${COPILOT_INSTALL_NOPROXY:-0}" != "1" ]; then
218	      printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: install stalled with the proxy env — retrying without it ..." >&2
219	      # Drop bun's cache lock dir before retrying; the killed attempt may have
220	      # left it behind, and a stale lock hangs the retry for the same reason.
221	      command rm -rf -- "${BUN_INSTALL:-$HOME/.bun}/install/cache/.tmp" 2>/dev/null
222	    fi
223	    if ! _copilot_pkg_install_try "$prefix" noproxy 90; then
224	      # Bun and Node do not always use the same CA store. A Clash/TUN node that
225	      # produces UNKNOWN_CERTIFICATE_VERIFICATION_ERROR in Bun can still be
226	      # installed safely by npm with normal TLS verification enabled.
227	      if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
228	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: Bun install failed — retrying with npm's CA stack ..." >&2
229	        if ! _copilot_pkg_install_try "$prefix" npm 90; then
230	          printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: could not install $spec — run 'copilot-proxy doctor'." >&2
231	          return 1
232	        fi
233	      else
234	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: could not install $spec — run 'copilot-proxy doctor'." >&2
235	        return 1
236	      fi
237	    fi
238	  fi
239	
240	  if [ ! -x "$bin" ]; then
241	    printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: install finished but $bin is missing." >&2
242	    return 1
243	  fi
244	  printf '%s\n' "$spec" >"$(_copilot_pkg_stamp)"
245	}
246	
247	# --- throttle shim (optional, in front of the fork) -----------------------------
248	# A tiny Bun reverse proxy that caps concurrent in-flight upstream requests,
249	# transparently retries 403/429 (GitHub enterprise abuse throttling) BEFORE any
250	# body streams — so downstream agents never see "Please run /login" — and keeps
251	# a streamed response alive with SSE comment frames while an OpenAI reasoning
252	# model thinks (copilot-api withholds headers until the first token and sends no
253	# `ping`, so the socket is otherwise silent for minutes and gets reaped; see
254	# pitfalls/copilot-proxy-openai-model-silent-stall.md). Toggle with
255	# `copilot-proxy shim on|off`; tune via COPILOT_SHIM_{PORT,MAX,RETRIES,
256	# BACKOFF_MS,PING_MS,PING_AFTER_MS,STALL_MS} — the whole COPILOT_SHIM_* env is
257	# inherited by the spawned process, so `export` them before `shim on`.
258	_copilot_shim_port()    { printf '%s' "${COPILOT_SHIM_PORT:-4142}"; }
259	_copilot_shim_base()    { printf 'http://localhost:%s' "$(_copilot_shim_port)"; }
260	_copilot_shim_script()  { printf '%s' "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/shell/copilot-throttle-shim.js"; }
261	_copilot_shim_logfile() { printf '%s' "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copilot-shim-$(_copilot_shim_port).log"; }
262	_copilot_shim_pidfile() { printf '%s' "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copilot-shim-$(_copilot_shim_port).pid"; }
263	_copilot_shim_state()   { printf '%s' "${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/copilot-proxy/shim"; }
264	
265	# Enabled? env COPILOT_PROXY_SHIM overrides a persisted on/off state file.
266	_copilot_shim_enabled() {
267	  case "${COPILOT_PROXY_SHIM:-}" in
268	    1|on|true|yes)  return 0 ;;
269	    0|off|false|no) return 1 ;;
270	  esac
271	  local sf; sf="$(_copilot_shim_state)"
272	  [ -f "$sf" ] && [ "$(command head -n1 "$sf" 2>/dev/null)" = "on" ]
273	}
274	
275	# Is the shim port answering at all? (curl w/o -f: any HTTP reply = exit 0, so a
276	# 502 from a fork-down passthrough still counts as "shim process is up".)
277	_copilot_shim_alive() {
278	  command curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 2 "$(_copilot_shim_base)/v1/models" >/dev/null 2>&1
279	}
280	
281	# Base URL Claude Code should talk to: the shim when it's enabled AND actually
282	# up, otherwise the fork directly (never break just because the shim is down).
283	_copilot_client_base() {
284	  if _copilot_shim_enabled && _copilot_shim_alive; then _copilot_shim_base; else _copilot_base; fi
285	}
286	
287	# Base URL for PERSISTENT pins (copilot-here settings.local.json): the shim when
288	# it's enabled (it's auto-started with the proxy, so it'll be up when in use),
289	# else the fork. Not gated on currently-alive since the file outlives this shell.
290	_copilot_pinned_base() {
291	  if _copilot_shim_enabled; then _copilot_shim_base; else _copilot_base; fi
292	}
293	
294	# Start the shim (idempotent). Points it at the fork; inherits COPILOT_SHIM_*.
295	_copilot_shim_start() {
296	  if _copilot_shim_alive; then return 0; fi
297	  if ! command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then
298	    printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: shim needs 'bun' (via mise) — skipping." >&2
299	    return 1
300	  fi
301	  local script; script="$(_copilot_shim_script)"
302	  if [ ! -f "$script" ]; then
303	    printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: shim script not found at $script" >&2
304	    return 1
305	  fi
306	  COPILOT_SHIM_PORT="$(_copilot_shim_port)" COPILOT_SHIM_UPSTREAM="$(_copilot_base)" \
307	    nohup bun "$script" >"$(_copilot_shim_logfile)" 2>&1 &
308	  printf '%s\n' "$!" >"$(_copilot_shim_pidfile)"
309	  local i=0
310	  while [ "$i" -lt 10 ]; do
311	    _copilot_shim_alive && return 0
312	    sleep 1; i=$((i + 1))
313	  done
314	  printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: shim did not come up — check $(_copilot_shim_logfile)" >&2
315	  return 1
316	}
317	
318	# Stop the shim.
319	_copilot_shim_stop() {
320	  local pidf; pidf="$(_copilot_shim_pidfile)"
321	  if [ -f "$pidf" ]; then
322	    local pid; pid="$(command cat "$pidf" 2>/dev/null)"
323	    [ -n "$pid" ] && kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null
324	    command rm -f -- "$pidf"
325	  fi
326	  command pkill -f "copilot-throttle-shim.js" 2>/dev/null
327	  return 0
328	}
329	
330	# Global default-model state file (used by copilot-run/claude-copilot when the
331	# project has no copilot-here pin). Written by `copilot-model`.
332	_copilot_model_state() {
333	  printf '%s' "${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/copilot-proxy/model"
334	}
335	
336	# Resolve the model for env injection: $COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL > state file > default.
337	#
338	# Model-id shape matters (verified 2026-07):
339	#   - HYPHENATED ids (claude-opus-4-8), not dotted (claude-opus-4.8): Claude
340	#     Code only recognizes hyphenated family names — dotted ids fall back to
341	#     a legacy "[Opus 4] retired" label AND a 200k context assumption.
342	#   - "[1m]" suffix: Claude Code uses it to size HUD/compaction for a 1M context
343	#     window. _copilot_model_for_claude derives it from live /v1/models metadata
344	#     for every provider, rather than guessing from a hard-coded Claude list.
345	#     Claude Code-only: raw API clients must send the plain id.
346	_copilot_default_model() {
347	  if [ -n "${COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL:-}" ]; then
348	    printf '%s' "$COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL"
349	  elif [ -f "$(_copilot_model_state)" ]; then
350	    command head -n 1 "$(_copilot_model_state)"
351	  else
352	    printf '%s' "gpt-5.6-sol[1m]"
353	  fi
354	}
355	
356	# Is the proxy answering on its port?
357	_copilot_alive() {
358	  command curl -fsS --max-time 2 "$(_copilot_base)/v1/models" >/dev/null 2>&1
359	}
360	
361	# --- doctor helpers -------------------------------------------------------------
362	
363	# Every model id the proxy will accept: the raw `.id` PLUS the `.claude_model_id`
364	# alias (which is the one carrying the "[1m]" suffix Claude Code sends). Checking
365	# only `.id` — as _copilot_model_list does — would reject a valid "...[1m]" pin.
366	_copilot_served_models() {
367	  local json
368	  json="$(command curl -fsS --max-time 5 "$(_copilot_base)/v1/models" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
369	  if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
370	    printf '%s\n' "$json" | jq -r '.data[] | .id, (.claude_model_id // empty)' 2>/dev/null | command sort -u
371	  else
372	    printf '%s\n' "$json" \
373	      | command grep -oE '"(id|claude_model_id)":"[^"]*"' \
374	      | command sed 's/.*":"//;s/"//' | command sort -u
375	  fi
376	}
377	
378	# The model Claude Code would actually send from THIS directory, and where it
379	# came from. Mirrors copilot-model's precedence: project pin > $COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL
380	# > state file > built-in default. Echoes "<model>|<source>" ('|' never occurs in
381	# a model id or a path we emit here).
382	_copilot_effective_model() {
383	  local settings=".claude/settings.local.json" m
384	  if [ -f "$settings" ] && command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 \
385	     && [ "$(jq -r '.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL // empty' "$settings" 2>/dev/null)" != "" ]; then
386	    m="$(jq -r '.env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL // empty' "$settings" 2>/dev/null)"
387	    if [ -n "$m" ]; then printf '%s|%s' "$m" "project pin: $settings"; return 0; fi
388	  fi
389	  if [ -n "${COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL:-}" ]; then
390	    printf '%s|%s' "$COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL" '$COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL'
391	  elif [ -f "$(_copilot_model_state)" ]; then
392	    printf '%s|%s' "$(command head -n 1 "$(_copilot_model_state)")" "state file: $(_copilot_model_state)"
393	  else
394	    printf '%s|%s' "$(_copilot_default_model)" "built-in default"
395	  fi
396	}
397	
398	# HTTP reachability probe. Any HTTP status means the host answered — an
399	# unauthenticated 400/401 from the Copilot API is a SUCCESSFUL reach. Only a
400	# connect/read failure is a fault. Echoes "<code>|<seconds>", empty on failure.
401	# $2, when non-empty, routes through that proxy (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7891).
402	_copilot_probe() {
403	  local url="$1" via="${2:-}" out
404	  if [ -n "$via" ]; then
405	    out="$(command curl -o /dev/null -s -w '%{http_code}|%{time_total}' --max-time 12 -x "$via" "$url" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
406	  else
407	    out="$(command curl -o /dev/null -s -w '%{http_code}|%{time_total}' --max-time 12 --noproxy '*' "$url" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
408	  fi
409	  case "$out" in 000*) return 1 ;; esac
410	  printf '%s' "$out"
411	}
412	
413	# Classify curl failures without treating an HTTP rejection as a transport
414	# failure. Kept separate so the optional codex_apps route can explain timeout,
415	# certificate and generic network failures without conflating them with the
416	# localhost model gateway.
417	_copilot_probe_failure_kind() {
418	  local rc="${1:-1}" msg
419	  msg="$(printf '%s' "${2:-}" | command tr 'A-Z' 'a-z')"
420	  case "$rc" in
421	    28) printf '%s' timeout; return 0 ;;
422	    35|51|53|58|59|60|64|66|77|80|82|83|90|91) printf '%s' tls; return 0 ;;
423	  esac
424	  case "$msg" in
425	    *timed\ out*|*timeout*) printf '%s' timeout ;;
426	    *certificate*|*ssl*|*tls*) printf '%s' tls ;;
427	    *) printf '%s' network ;;
428	  esac
429	}
430	
431	# Probe an optional HTTP endpoint and always emit a structured result:
432	#   reached|HTTP_CODE|SECONDS|
433	#   failed|timeout|SECONDS|short curl error
434	#   failed|tls|SECONDS|short curl error
435	#   failed|network|SECONDS|short curl error
436	# Any non-000 HTTP status is reachability success; auth/handshake rejection is
437	# expected for the unauthenticated codex_apps endpoint probe.
438	_copilot_optional_http_probe() {
439	  local url="$1" via="${2:-}" out rc metrics code elapsed err kind
440	  if [ -n "$via" ]; then
441	    out="$(command curl -o /dev/null -sS -w '\n%{http_code}|%{time_total}' \
442	      --max-time 12 -x "$via" "$url" 2>&1)"; rc=$?
443	  else
444	    out="$(command curl -o /dev/null -sS -w '\n%{http_code}|%{time_total}' \
445	      --max-time 12 --noproxy '*' "$url" 2>&1)"; rc=$?
446	  fi
447	  metrics="$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | command tail -n 1)"
448	  code="${metrics%%|*}"; elapsed="${metrics##*|}"
449	  if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && [ -n "$code" ] && [ "$code" != 000 ]; then
450	    printf 'reached|%s|%s|' "$code" "$elapsed"
451	    return 0
452	  fi
453	  err="$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | command sed '$d' | command tr '\n|' ' /' | command cut -c1-120)"
454	  kind="$(_copilot_probe_failure_kind "$rc" "$err")"
455	  printf 'failed|%s|%s|%s' "$kind" "${elapsed:-0}" "$err"
456	}
457	
458	# Model ids GitHub serves for this account RIGHT NOW.
459	#
460	# Why this exists: copilot-api fetches /models ONCE at startup and caches it for
461	# the whole process lifetime. A degraded OR geo-filtered startup fetch leaves
462	# the proxy serving a truncated list forever, and every request for a missing
463	# model returns a 400 "model_not_supported" that looks exactly like an
464	# entitlement problem. Comparing live-upstream against proxy-cached is the only
465	# way to tell those apart. Verified 2026-07.
466	#
467	# $1 selects the egress path for the curl probe (curl follows the macOS system
468	# proxy by default — which is exactly what made the old doctor mis-diagnose
469	# "entitlement" when System Proxy was ON but Node was going direct):
470	#   (empty)           — curl defaults (may use System Proxy on macOS)
471	#   direct            — --noproxy '*' (true direct egress)
472	#   http://host:port  — force -x that proxy
473	#
474	# Secrets: the ghu_/bearer tokens are passed via `curl -K -` (stdin config), NOT
475	# argv — argv is world-readable via `ps`. Never echo either token.
476	_copilot_upstream_models() {
477	  local via="${1:-}"
478	  local tokfile="$HOME/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token"
479	  [ -f "$tokfile" ] || return 1
480	  command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
481	
482	  local ghu ex api ctok up
483	  ghu="$(command head -n 1 "$tokfile" 2>/dev/null)"
484	  [ -n "$ghu" ] || return 1
485	
486	  # Transport: keep as one argv word so zsh doesn't glob `*`.
487	  local xargs=()
488	  case "$via" in
489	    "") ;;
490	    direct) xargs=(--noproxy '*') ;;
491	    http://*|https://*|socks5://*|socks5h://*) xargs=(-x "$via") ;;
492	    *) return 1 ;;
493	  esac
494	
495	  # bash arrays work when this file is sourced from bash; zsh too. Avoid
496	  # unquoted $* expansion of `--noproxy *`.
497	  ex="$(printf 'header = "Authorization: token %s"\n' "$ghu" \
498	        | command curl -fsS --max-time 10 -K - \
499	            -H 'user-agent: GitHubCopilotChat/0.26.7' \
500	            "${xargs[@]}" \
501	            https://api.github.com/copilot_internal/v2/token 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
502	
503	  api="$(printf '%s' "$ex" | jq -r '.endpoints.api // "https://api.githubcopilot.com"' 2>/dev/null)"
504	  ctok="$(printf '%s' "$ex" | jq -r '.token // empty' 2>/dev/null)"
505	  [ -n "$ctok" ] || return 1
506	
507	  up="$(printf 'header = "Authorization: Bearer %s"\n' "$ctok" \
508	        | command curl -fsS --max-time 12 -K - \
509	            -H 'user-agent: GitHubCopilotChat/0.26.7' \
510	            -H 'copilot-integration-id: vscode-chat' \
511	            "${xargs[@]}" \
512	            "$api/models" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
513	
514	  printf '%s' "$up" | jq -r '.data[]?.id // empty' 2>/dev/null | command sort -u
515	}
516	
517	# Resolve the HTTP(S) proxy URL that Node should use for GitHub /models.
518	# Prints a URL or nothing. Never prints secrets. Relies on 50_networking.sh
519	# helpers when available; falls back to macOS System Proxy / common ports.
520	#
521	# COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY:
522	#   auto|always|never|<url>
523	_copilot_resolve_http_proxy() {
524	  local mode="${COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY:-auto}"
525	  case "$mode" in
526	    never|off|0|false|no) return 0 ;;
527	    http://*|https://*|socks5://*|socks5h://*)
528	      printf '%s' "$mode"
529	      return 0
530	      ;;
531	    always|auto|on|1|true|yes|"") ;;
532	    *)
533	      printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: unknown COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY='$mode' (use auto|always|never|http://...)" >&2
534	      return 0
535	      ;;
536	  esac
537	
538	  # Prefer the shared detector (Clash Verge / mihomo / CFW / System Proxy).
539	  if command -v __net_detect_proxy >/dev/null 2>&1; then
540	    if __net_detect_proxy 2>/dev/null \
541	       && [ -n "${_NET_PROXY_CACHE:-}" ] \
542	       && [ "$_NET_PROXY_CACHE" != "none" ]; then
543	      printf '%s' "$_NET_PROXY_CACHE"
544	      return 0
545	    fi
546	  fi
547	
548	  # Fallback when 50_networking.sh isn't sourced yet (rare; file order is 43→50).
549	  local sys
550	  sys="$(_copilot_system_proxy)"
551	  if [ -n "$sys" ]; then
552	    printf '%s' "http://$sys"
553	    return 0
554	  fi
555	  return 0
556	}
557	
558	# Normalise a model id for cross-source comparison: lowercase, dots -> dashes
559	# (upstream says claude-opus-4.8, the proxy says claude-opus-4-8), drop the
560	# Claude Code-only "[1m]" suffix. Reads ids on stdin, one per line.
561	_copilot_norm_models() {
562	  command tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | command sed 's/\[1m\]$//; s/\./-/g' | command sort -u
563	}
564	
565	# macOS system HTTP proxy as "host:port", empty when disabled/not macOS.
566	_copilot_system_proxy() {
567	  command -v scutil >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
568	  command scutil --proxy 2>/dev/null | command awk '
569	    /HTTPEnable/ { en=$3 } /HTTPProxy/ { h=$3 } /HTTPPort/ { p=$3 }
570	    END { if (en == 1 && h != "" && p != "") printf "%s:%s", h, p }'
571	}
572	
573	# PIDs of bun package-installer processes still resolving copilot-api, one per
574	# line (empty when none). bun stalls indefinitely resolving through a socks
575	# ALL_PROXY (even when curl to the same registry is fine), and a stalled
576	# `bun add` keeps bun's global install-cache lock — which wedges every later
577	# install too. _copilot_pkg_install_try now bounds and kills its own attempts, so
578	# this should stay empty; it remains as a safety net for a stall we didn't spawn
579	# (a hand-run `bunx @jeffreycao/copilot-api`, or a zombie left by the pre-install
580	# design that resolved on every launch). A live `bun add … copilot-api` is never
581	# normal at rest — install is a one-shot — so a match is a clean signal.
582	# Verified 2026-07: five stacked zombies from five retries, none ever bound the port.
583	_copilot_stale_installers() {
584	  command pgrep -f 'bun add.*copilot-api' 2>/dev/null
585	}
586	
587	# --- proxy manager --------------------------------------------------------------
588	
589	# Manage the copilot-api proxy. Subcommands: start|stop|status|restart|logs|auth.
590	# Example:
591	#   copilot-proxy start          # background-start on $COPILOT_PROXY_PORT
592	#   copilot-proxy status         # is it up? which models?
593	copilot-proxy() {
594	  if [ -n "$ZSH_VERSION" ]; then
595	    emulate -L zsh
596	    setopt localoptions pipefail
597	  else
598	    set -o pipefail
599	  fi
600	
601	  if ! command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then
602	    printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: bun not found (needs bun via mise)." >&2
603	    return 1
604	  fi
605	
606	  local port pkg logf pidf
607	  port="$(_copilot_port)"; pkg="$(_copilot_pkg)"
608	  logf="$(_copilot_logfile)"; pidf="$(_copilot_pidfile)"
609	
610	  local action="${1:-status}"
611	  case "$action" in
612	    start)
613	      if _copilot_alive; then
614	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: already running on port $port" >&2
615	        return 0
616	      fi
617	      # First run needs `copilot-proxy auth` to store a ghu_ token; warn if absent.
618	      if [ ! -f "$HOME/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token" ]; then
619	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: not authenticated yet — run 'copilot-proxy auth' first." >&2
620	        return 1
621	      fi
622	      # Rotate the previous session's log (keep last 3) so a restart doesn't wipe
623	      # it — the start commands below truncate ($logf) via `>`. logf.1 = previous
624	      # session, logf.2/.3 = older. Debugging a transient (e.g. 403) survives.
625	      if [ -f "$logf" ]; then
626	        command rm -f "$logf.3" 2>/dev/null
627	        [ -f "$logf.2" ] && command mv -f "$logf.2" "$logf.3"
628	        [ -f "$logf.1" ] && command mv -f "$logf.1" "$logf.2"
629	        command mv -f "$logf" "$logf.1"
630	      fi
631	      # Install the pinned package BEFORE backgrounding anything. Resolving it at
632	      # launch (the old `bunx <pkg> start`) is what used to hang forever behind a
633	      # socks proxy, with nothing but "Resolving dependencies" in the log.
634	      _copilot_ensure_pkg || return 1
635	      local bin srv_pid http_proxy_url use_proxy_env=0
636	      bin="$(_copilot_pkg_bin)"
637	      http_proxy_url="$(_copilot_resolve_http_proxy)"
638	      if [ -n "$http_proxy_url" ]; then
639	        use_proxy_env=1
640	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: Node will fetch /models via $http_proxy_url (--proxy-env; COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=${COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY:-auto})"
641	      else
642	        case "${COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY:-auto}" in
643	          always|on|1|true|yes)
644	            printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=always but no local proxy detected — starting DIRECT (Claude catalog may be geo-filtered)." >&2
645	            printf '%s\n' "  hint: start Clash Verge / mihomo, or set COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7897" >&2
646	            ;;
647	        esac
648	      fi
649	
650	      # Flag sets differ per package: only the original has --rate-limit/--wait
651	      # (the fork ships no rate limiter — mitigate with COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET=1).
652	      # --proxy-env makes Node honour HTTPS_PROXY (macOS System Proxy alone is ignored).
653	      if [ "$(_copilot_pkg_flavor)" = "original" ]; then
654	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: starting ($pkg) on port $port (rate-limit ${COPILOT_PROXY_RATE:-15}s) ..."
655	        # Original package: HTTPS_PROXY alone is enough (no --proxy-env flag).
656	        if [ "$use_proxy_env" -eq 1 ]; then
657	          nohup env HTTP_PROXY="$http_proxy_url" HTTPS_PROXY="$http_proxy_url" \
658	            http_proxy="$http_proxy_url" https_proxy="$http_proxy_url" \
659	            "$bin" start \
660	            --port "$port" \
661	            --rate-limit "${COPILOT_PROXY_RATE:-15}" \
662	            --wait \
663	            >"$logf" 2>&1 &
664	        else
665	          nohup "$bin" start \
666	            --port "$port" \
667	            --rate-limit "${COPILOT_PROXY_RATE:-15}" \
668	            --wait \
669	            >"$logf" 2>&1 &
670	        fi
671	      else
672	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: starting ($pkg) on port $port ..."
673	        # Fork: needs --proxy-env so Node fetch honours HTTPS_PROXY.
674	        if [ "$use_proxy_env" -eq 1 ]; then
675	          nohup env HTTP_PROXY="$http_proxy_url" HTTPS_PROXY="$http_proxy_url" \
676	            http_proxy="$http_proxy_url" https_proxy="$http_proxy_url" \
677	            "$bin" start \
678	            --port "$port" \
679	            --proxy-env \
680	            >"$logf" 2>&1 &
681	        else
682	          nohup "$bin" start \
683	            --port "$port" \
684	            >"$logf" 2>&1 &
685	        fi
686	      fi
687	      srv_pid=$!
688	      printf '%s\n' "$srv_pid" >"$pidf"
689	      # Catalog startup can exceed 20s on a slow Clash/TUN hop even though the
690	      # process is healthy. Keep checking the child so true crashes still fail
691	      # immediately; only the network-bound model refresh gets a wider budget.
692	      local i=0 start_timeout="${COPILOT_PROXY_START_TIMEOUT:-45}"
693	      while [ "$i" -lt "$start_timeout" ]; do
694	        if _copilot_alive; then
695	          if _copilot_shim_enabled; then
696	            _copilot_shim_start && printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: throttle shim up → $(_copilot_shim_base) (→ $(_copilot_base))"
697	          fi
698	          printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: up → $(_copilot_client_base)  (logs: copilot-proxy logs)"
699	          return 0
700	        fi
701	        # Crashed on its own (bad flag, port taken, auth) — don't sit out the
702	        # remaining seconds pretending we're still waiting.
703	        if ! kill -0 "$srv_pid" 2>/dev/null; then
704	          command rm -f -- "$pidf"
705	          printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: server exited during startup — check 'copilot-proxy logs'." >&2
706	          return 1
707	        fi
708	        sleep 1
709	        i=$((i + 1))
710	      done
711	      # Timed out. REAP what we spawned: the old code returned and left it running,
712	      # so each retry stacked another orphan (5 of them, in the wild) and none ever
713	      # bound the port.
714	      kill "$srv_pid" 2>/dev/null
715	      command rm -f -- "$pidf"
716	      printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: did not come up in time — check 'copilot-proxy logs'." >&2
717	      return 1
718	      ;;
719	    stop)
720	      # Tear down the shim first (harmless if not running).
721	      _copilot_shim_stop
722	      # Prefer the tracked pid; fall back to a broad match.
723	      if [ -f "$pidf" ]; then
724	        local pid; pid="$(cat "$pidf" 2>/dev/null)"
725	        [ -n "$pid" ] && kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null
726	        command rm -f -- "$pidf"
727	      fi
728	      command pkill -f "copilot-api.*--port $port" 2>/dev/null
729	      sleep 1
730	      if _copilot_alive; then
731	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: still answering on $port (another instance?)" >&2
732	        return 1
733	      fi
734	      printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: stopped (port $port free)"
735	      ;;
736	    restart)
737	      copilot-proxy stop
738	      copilot-proxy start
739	      ;;
740	    status)
741	      if _copilot_alive; then
742	        local status_json status_count status_claude
743	        status_json="$(command curl -fsS --max-time 3 "$(_copilot_base)/v1/models" 2>/dev/null || true)"
744	        status_count="$(printf '%s' "$status_json" | jq -r '.data | length' 2>/dev/null || printf '?')"
745	        status_claude="$(printf '%s' "$status_json" | jq -r '[.data[]?.id | select(startswith("claude-"))] | join(" ")' 2>/dev/null)"
746	        [ -n "$status_claude" ] || status_claude='none'
747	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: RUNNING on $(_copilot_base)"
748	        printf '%s\n' "  models: $status_count served; Claude: $status_claude"
749	        if _copilot_shim_enabled; then
750	          if _copilot_shim_alive; then
751	            printf '%s\n' "  shim:   ON, up on $(_copilot_shim_base)  → clients use this"
752	          else
753	            printf '%s\n' "  shim:   ON but DOWN (clients fall back to $(_copilot_base); try 'copilot-proxy shim on')"
754	          fi
755	        else
756	          printf '%s\n' "  shim:   off  (enable: copilot-proxy shim on)"
757	        fi
758	      else
759	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: not running on port $port  (start: copilot-proxy start)"
760	        return 1
761	      fi
762	      ;;
763	    doctor|test)
764	      # Diagnose the whole path: prereqs -> auth -> proxy -> model entitlement
765	      # -> upstream reachability -> (optional) a real inference round-trip.
766	      #
767	      # The model-entitlement check is the one that matters most: a Copilot plan
768	      # that serves no Anthropic models fails EVERY request with a 400
769	      # "model_not_supported", which reads like a network fault in the logs but
770	      # is an account-policy fact no amount of proxy tuning will fix.
771	      local _live=0
772	      case "${2:-}" in --live) _live=1 ;; esac
773	
774	      # Colour only when stdout is a terminal, so `copilot-proxy doctor | tee`
775	      # and CI capture stay readable. printf (not $'..') keeps this sh-portable.
776	      local _g='' _r_='' _y='' _z=''
777	      if [ -t 1 ]; then
778	        _g="$(printf '\033[32m')"; _r_="$(printf '\033[31m')"
779	        _y="$(printf '\033[33m')"; _z="$(printf '\033[0m')"
780	      fi
781	
782	      local _fail=0 _warn=0
783	      _ok()   { printf '  %s✓%s %-16s %s\n' "$_g" "$_z" "$1" "$2"; }
784	      _bad()  { printf '  %s✗%s %-16s %s\n' "$_r_" "$_z" "$1" "$2"; _fail=$((_fail+1)); }
785	      _note() { printf '  %s!%s %-16s %s\n' "$_y" "$_z" "$1" "$2"; _warn=$((_warn+1)); }
786	      _skip() { printf '  · %-16s %s\n' "$1" "$2"; }
787	      _hint() { printf '    %-16s → %s\n' "" "$1"; }
788	
789	      printf '\ncopilot-proxy doctor   port %s   pkg %s\n\n' "$port" "$pkg"
790	
791	      printf '%s\n' "Prerequisites"
792	      local _tool
793	      for _tool in bun curl jq; do
794	        if command -v "$_tool" >/dev/null 2>&1; then _ok "$_tool" "$(command -v "$_tool")"
795	        elif [ "$_tool" = jq ]; then _note "$_tool" "not found — some checks degrade to grep"
796	        else _bad "$_tool" "not found"; fi
797	      done
798	
799	      printf '\n%s\n' "Package"
800	      # The proxy runs an INSTALLED binary, not `bunx <pkg>` — so a warm start does
801	      # no network at all. An un-installed prefix is not a fault: the next start
802	      # installs it once.
803	      if _copilot_pkg_ready; then
804	        _ok "installed" "$pkg"
805	        _skip "bin" "$(_copilot_pkg_bin)"
806	      else
807	        _note "not installed" "$pkg — the next 'copilot-proxy start' installs it (one-time)"
808	        _hint "copilot-proxy reinstall   # or force it now"
809	      fi
810	
811	      printf '\n%s\n' "Authentication"
812	      local _tok="$HOME/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token"
813	      if [ -f "$_tok" ]; then _ok "token file" "$_tok"
814	      else _bad "token file" "absent"; _hint "copilot-proxy auth"; fi
815	
816	      printf '\n%s\n' "Proxy"
817	      if _copilot_alive; then _ok "listening" "$(_copilot_base)"
818	      else
819	        _bad "listening" "nothing answering on port $port"
820	        _hint "copilot-proxy start"
821	      fi
822	      # A wedged package installer is the non-obvious reason a proxy never binds
823	      # the port (see _copilot_stale_installers): 'copilot-proxy start' just says
824	      # "did not come up in time" and the log shows only "Resolving dependencies".
825	      # Flag it hard when nothing is listening (this IS the fault), softer when
826	      # the proxy is up (a leftover, but still worth clearing — it holds bun's
827	      # cache lock and will hang the next restart).
828	      local _stale _stale_n
829	      _stale="$(_copilot_stale_installers)"
830	      if [ -n "$_stale" ]; then
831	        _stale_n="$(printf '%s\n' "$_stale" | command grep -c .)"
832	        if _copilot_alive; then
833	          _note "stale installer" "$_stale_n leftover 'bun add … copilot-api' proc(s) — harmless now, but they hold bun's cache lock (a restart will hang)"
834	        else
835	          _bad "stale installer" "$_stale_n wedged 'bun add … copilot-api' proc(s) — start is blocked at \"Resolving dependencies\", never binds port $port"
836	        fi
837	        _hint "pkill -f 'bun add.*copilot-api'; rm -rf \"\$HOME/.bun/install/cache/.tmp\"/*; copilot-proxy start"
838	        _hint "re-hangs? bun is stalling on the socks proxy — env -u ALL_PROXY -u HTTPS_PROXY -u HTTP_PROXY copilot-proxy start"
839	      else
840	        _skip "installer" "no wedged 'bun add' process"
841	      fi
842	      if _copilot_shim_enabled; then
843	        if _copilot_shim_alive; then _ok "throttle shim" "up on $(_copilot_shim_base) → clients use this"
844	        else _bad "throttle shim" "enabled but DOWN"; _hint "copilot-proxy shim on"; fi
845	      else
846	        _skip "throttle shim" "off"
847	      fi
848	
849	      printf '\n%s\n' "Models"
850	      local _served _n _claude _model _src _pin _profile _profile_catalog
851	      local _role_rows _role _role_model _role_bad
852	      local _http_proxy _up_direct _up_via _dir_n _dir_c _via_n _via_c
853	      _http_proxy="$(_copilot_resolve_http_proxy)"
854	      if [ -n "$_http_proxy" ]; then
855	        _note "http proxy" "$_http_proxy (COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=${COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY:-auto}) — Node needs --proxy-env to use this"
856	      else
857	        _skip "http proxy" "none detected (COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=${COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY:-auto})"
858	      fi
859	
860	      if _served="$(_copilot_served_models)" && [ -n "$_served" ]; then
861	        _n="$(printf '%s\n' "$_served" | command grep -c .)"
862	        _claude="$(printf '%s\n' "$_served" | command grep -ci '^claude' || true)"
863	        _ok "served" "$_n model ids"
864	        if [ "$_claude" -gt 0 ]; then
865	          _ok "claude models" "$_claude ids available"
866	        else
867	          _note "claude models" "0 of $_n — Anthropic unavailable; role-aware OpenAI fallback will be used"
868	        fi
869	
870	        # A/B: true-direct vs via local Clash/Verge. GitHub geo-filters the
871	        # Claude catalog on CN egress; curl's default path follows System Proxy
872	        # so a single "upstream" probe used to mis-label that as entitlement.
873	        _dir_c=0; _via_c=0
874	        if _up_direct="$(_copilot_upstream_models direct)" && [ -n "$_up_direct" ]; then
875	          _dir_n="$(printf '%s\n' "$_up_direct" | command grep -c .)"
876	          _dir_c="$(printf '%s\n' "$_up_direct" | command grep -ci '^claude' || true)"
877	          _ok "upstream direct" "$_dir_n ids, $_dir_c claude (--noproxy)"
878	        else
879	          _skip "upstream direct" "could not query GitHub direct (need token + jq, or blocked)"
880	        fi
881	        if [ -n "$_http_proxy" ]; then
882	          if _up_via="$(_copilot_upstream_models "$_http_proxy")" && [ -n "$_up_via" ]; then
883	            _via_n="$(printf '%s\n' "$_up_via" | command grep -c .)"
884	            _via_c="$(printf '%s\n' "$_up_via" | command grep -ci '^claude' || true)"
885	            _ok "upstream via proxy" "$_via_n ids, $_via_c claude ($_http_proxy)"
886	          else
887	            _bad "upstream via proxy" "no response through $_http_proxy"
888	            _hint "Clash/mihomo node may be down — try another PROXY selection"
889	          fi
890	        fi
891	
892	        if [ "$_via_c" -gt 0 ] && [ "$_dir_c" -eq 0 ]; then
893	          _note "egress geo" "Claude appears ONLY via local proxy — GitHub filters Anthropic on direct/CN egress"
894	          if [ "$_claude" -eq 0 ]; then
895	            _bad "MISSING --proxy-env" "copilot-api started without HTTPS_PROXY, so it cached the direct (no-Claude) catalog"
896	            _hint "copilot-proxy restart   # auto uses --proxy-env when a local proxy is detected"
897	            _hint "or: COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7897 copilot-proxy restart"
898	          fi
899	        elif [ "$_via_c" -eq 0 ] && [ "$_dir_c" -eq 0 ] && [ -n "${_up_direct}${_up_via}" ]; then
900	          _note "entitlement" "neither direct nor via-proxy catalogs include Claude"
901	          _hint "org Copilot policy may disable Anthropic — a restart will NOT help"
902	        elif [ "$_claude" -eq 0 ] && [ "$_via_c" -gt 0 ]; then
903	          _bad "STALE CACHE" "via-proxy upstream has Claude but the running process does not"
904	          _hint "copilot-proxy restart"
905	        elif [ "$_claude" -gt 0 ]; then
906	          _ok "cache" "served Claude list looks healthy"
907	        fi
908	
909	        _pin="$(_copilot_effective_model)"
910	        _model="${_pin%%|*}"; _src="${_pin##*|}"
911	        if printf '%s\n' "$_served" | command grep -qxF "$_model"; then
912	          _ok "pinned model" "$_model  ($_src)"
913	        else
914	          _bad "pinned model" "$_model  ($_src)"
915	          _hint "not in the served list → every request returns 400 model_not_supported"
916	          _hint "copilot-model --auto   # Claude; else capability-ranked OpenAI, then Gemini"
917	          _hint "copilot-model -l       # list served ids"
918	        fi
919	
920	        # Validate the aliases Claude Code may use for background/subagent work,
921	        # not just ANTHROPIC_MODEL. One stale Sonnet/Haiku id is enough to make
922	        # selected features fail with 400 while ordinary chat still succeeds.
923	        if [ -f ".claude/settings.local.json" ] \
924	           && [ -n "$(jq -r '.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL // empty' ".claude/settings.local.json" 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
925	          _profile="$(jq '{
926	            main: (.env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL // ""),
927	            fable: (.env.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL // ""),
928	            opus: (.env.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL // ""),
929	            sonnet: (.env.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL // ""),
930	            haiku: (.env.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL // "")
931	          }' ".claude/settings.local.json" 2>/dev/null)"
932	        else
933	          _profile_catalog="$(_copilot_model_catalog 2>/dev/null || true)"
934	          _profile="$(_copilot_model_profile_json "$_model" "$_profile_catalog" 2>/dev/null || true)"
935	        fi
936	        _role_bad=''
937	        if [ -n "$_profile" ]; then
938	          _role_rows="$(printf '%s' "$_profile" | jq -r '
939	            ["fable",.fable], ["opus",.opus], ["sonnet",.sonnet], ["haiku",.haiku]
940	            | @tsv' 2>/dev/null)"
941	          while IFS="$(printf '\t')" read -r _role _role_model; do
942	            [ -n "$_role" ] || continue
943	            if [ -z "$_role_model" ]; then
944	              _bad "role $_role" "unset — Claude Code may choose its native default and get model_not_supported"
945	              _role_bad=1
946	            elif ! printf '%s\n' "$_served" | command grep -qxF "$_role_model"; then
947	              _bad "role $_role" "$_role_model is not served"
948	              _role_bad=1
949	            fi
950	          done <<EOF
951	$_role_rows
952	EOF
953	          if [ -z "$_role_bad" ]; then
954	            _ok "model roles" "$(printf '%s' "$_profile" | jq -r '"fable=\(.fable), opus=\(.opus), sonnet=\(.sonnet), haiku=\(.haiku)"')"
955	          else
956	            _hint "copilot-model --auto   # rewrite main + every Claude Code role alias"
957	          fi
958	        else
959	          _bad "model roles" "could not compute the effective role profile"
960	        fi
961	      else
962	        _bad "served" "could not fetch $(_copilot_base)/v1/models"
963	        # Still run the A/B so a stopped proxy doesn't hide the geo diagnosis.
964	        if _up_direct="$(_copilot_upstream_models direct)" && [ -n "$_up_direct" ]; then
965	          _dir_c="$(printf '%s\n' "$_up_direct" | command grep -ci '^claude' || true)"
966	          _ok "upstream direct" "$(printf '%s\n' "$_up_direct" | command grep -c .) ids, $_dir_c claude"
967	        fi
968	        if [ -n "$_http_proxy" ] && _up_via="$(_copilot_upstream_models "$_http_proxy")" && [ -n "$_up_via" ]; then
969	          _via_c="$(printf '%s\n' "$_up_via" | command grep -ci '^claude' || true)"
970	          _ok "upstream via proxy" "$(printf '%s\n' "$_up_via" | command grep -c .) ids, $_via_c claude"
971	          if [ "$_via_c" -gt 0 ]; then
972	            _hint "start with proxy: copilot-proxy start   # will attach --proxy-env automatically"
973	          fi
974	        fi
975	      fi
976	
977	      printf '\n%s\n' "Upstream (GitHub Copilot API)"
978	      local _sysproxy _r _code _t
979	      _sysproxy="$(_copilot_system_proxy)"
980	      for _h in api.enterprise.githubcopilot.com api.githubcopilot.com; do
981	        if _r="$(_copilot_probe "https://$_h/models")"; then
982	          _code="${_r%%|*}"; _t="${_r##*|}"
983	          _ok "$_h" "direct HTTP $_code in ${_t}s"
984	        else
985	          _bad "$_h" "direct — no response within 12s"
986	          _hint "connection blocked or upstream unreachable without a proxy"
987	        fi
988	        if [ -n "$_sysproxy" ]; then
989	          if _r="$(_copilot_probe "https://$_h/models" "http://$_sysproxy")"; then
990	            _code="${_r%%|*}"; _t="${_r##*|}"
991	            _ok "$_h" "via $_sysproxy HTTP $_code in ${_t}s"
992	          else
993	            _bad "$_h" "via $_sysproxy — no response within 12s"
994	            _hint "your system proxy cannot reach this host; bypass it or fix the rule"
995	          fi
996	        fi
997	      done
998	      _skip "" "HTTP 400/401 = reached (an unauthenticated probe is expected to be rejected)"
999	
1000	      printf '\n%s\n' "Network / local proxy"
1001	      if [ -n "$_sysproxy" ]; then
1002	        _note "system proxy" "$_sysproxy (macOS HTTP+HTTPS)"
1003	        local _ph="${_sysproxy%%:*}" _pp="${_sysproxy##*:}"
1004	        if command nc -z -G 2 "$_ph" "$_pp" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1005	          _ok "proxy port" "$_sysproxy is listening"
1006	        else
1007	          _bad "proxy port" "$_sysproxy is NOT listening — system proxy points at a dead port"
1008	          _hint "start Clash/mihomo, or turn the macOS system proxy off"
1009	        fi
1010	      else
1011	        _skip "system proxy" "disabled"
1012	      fi
1013	      if command pgrep -f -i 'clash|mihomo' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1014	        _note "clash/mihomo" "running — long streaming POSTs can be dropped by a flaky node"
1015	        _hint "an ETIMEDOUT mid-request (not at connect) usually means the proxy node died"
1016	      else
1017	        _skip "clash/mihomo" "not running"
1018	      fi
1019	      if [ -n "${HTTPS_PROXY:-${https_proxy:-}}" ]; then
1020	        _note "env proxy" "HTTPS_PROXY is set — bun/node honour this (and --proxy-env), the macOS System Proxy alone they ignore"
1021	      else
1022	        _skip "env proxy" "HTTPS_PROXY unset in this shell (copilot-proxy start auto-injects it when a local proxy is detected)"
1023	      fi
1024	
1025	      printf '\n%s\n' "Codex Apps (ChatGPT MCP)"
1026	      _skip "route" "https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/apps — independent of localhost inference and Codex Desktop"
1027	      if [ "$_live" -ne 1 ]; then
1028	        _skip "skipped" "pass --live to probe the optional Apps/Connectors MCP route (no inference quota)"
1029	      else
1030	        local _apps_url _apps_direct _apps_via _as _av _at _ae
1031	        local _direct_apps_ok=0 _via_apps_ok=0
1032	        _apps_url='https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/apps'
1033	        _apps_direct="$(_copilot_optional_http_probe "$_apps_url")"
1034	        IFS='|' read -r _as _av _at _ae <<EOF
1035	$_apps_direct
1036	EOF
1037	        if [ "$_as" = reached ]; then
1038	          _direct_apps_ok=1
1039	          _ok "apps direct" "HTTP $_av in ${_at}s (HTTP rejection still proves reachability)"
1040	        else
1041	          _note "apps direct" "$_av failure after ${_at}s${_ae:+ — $_ae}"
1042	        fi
1043	
1044	        if [ -n "$_http_proxy" ]; then
1045	          _apps_via="$(_copilot_optional_http_probe "$_apps_url" "$_http_proxy")"
1046	          IFS='|' read -r _as _av _at _ae <<EOF
1047	$_apps_via
1048	EOF
1049	          if [ "$_as" = reached ]; then
1050	            _via_apps_ok=1
1051	            _ok "apps via proxy" "HTTP $_av in ${_at}s ($_http_proxy)"
1052	          elif [ "$_direct_apps_ok" -eq 1 ]; then
1053	            _skip "apps via proxy" "$_av failure; direct route already works"
1054	          else
1055	            _note "apps via proxy" "$_av failure after ${_at}s${_ae:+ — $_ae}"
1056	          fi
1057	        fi
1058	
1059	        if [ "$_direct_apps_ok" -eq 0 ] && [ "$_via_apps_ok" -eq 1 ]; then
1060	          _note "apps routing" "ChatGPT Apps works only through the explicit HTTP proxy"
1061	          _hint "launch Codex with HTTP_PROXY=$_http_proxy HTTPS_PROXY=$_http_proxy (and NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1,::1)"
1062	        elif [ "$_direct_apps_ok" -eq 0 ] && [ "$_via_apps_ok" -eq 0 ]; then
1063	          _hint "this affects Apps/Connectors only; /status can still show localhost model inference working"
1064	          _hint "timeout → inspect Clash/TUN rules; tls → inspect certificate interception / custom CA"
1065	        fi
1066	      fi
1067	
1068	      printf '\n%s\n' "Live probe"
1069	      if [ "$_live" -ne 1 ]; then
1070	        _skip "skipped" "pass --live to send one real request (consumes 1 quota unit)"
1071	      elif ! _copilot_alive; then
1072	        _skip "skipped" "proxy is not running"
1073	      elif [ -z "${_served:-}" ]; then
1074	        _skip "skipped" "no served model to probe with"
1075	      else
1076	        # Pick a chat model, never an embedding one, and never a "[1m]" alias:
1077	        # that suffix is Claude Code-only sugar and the proxy rejects it from a
1078	        # raw API client (see _copilot_default_model's notes).
1079	        local _probe_model _body
1080	        _probe_model="$(printf '%s\n' "$_served" \
1081	          | command grep -vi 'embedding' | command grep -v '\[1m\]' | command head -n 1)"
1082	        _body="$(printf '{"model":"%s","max_tokens":1,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}' "$_probe_model")"
1083	        # Probe the base CLIENTS use (the shim when it's up), so the live check
1084	        # exercises the same chain Claude Code does.
1085	        if _r="$(command curl -o /dev/null -s -w '%{http_code}|%{time_total}' --max-time 60 \
1086	                   -X POST "$(_copilot_client_base)/v1/messages?beta=true" \
1087	                   -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "$_body" 2>/dev/null)"; then
1088	          _code="${_r%%|*}"; _t="${_r##*|}"
1089	          case "$_code" in
1090	            2*) _ok "round-trip" "$_probe_model → HTTP $_code in ${_t}s" ;;
1091	            000) _bad "round-trip" "$_probe_model → no response (timeout/reset)"
1092	                 _hint "this is the streaming-fault class; suspect the local proxy chain" ;;
1093	            *)  _bad "round-trip" "$_probe_model → HTTP $_code in ${_t}s"
1094	                _hint "copilot-proxy logs 40" ;;
1095	          esac
1096	        else
1097	          _bad "round-trip" "request failed outright"
1098	        fi
1099	      fi
1100	
1101	      printf '\n'
1102	      if [ "$_fail" -gt 0 ]; then
1103	        printf '%s\n\n' "$_fail failed, $_warn warning(s)"
1104	        unset -f _ok _bad _note _skip _hint 2>/dev/null
1105	        return 1
1106	      fi
1107	      printf '%s\n\n' "all checks passed ($_warn warning(s))"
1108	      unset -f _ok _bad _note _skip _hint 2>/dev/null
1109	      ;;
1110	    logs)
1111	      # logs [N] [gen]  — tail the fork log; gen 1..3 = a rotated prev session.
1112	      # logs shim [N]    — tail the throttle shim's log instead.
1113	      local _lf _n
1114	      if [ "${2:-}" = "shim" ]; then
1115	        _lf="$(_copilot_shim_logfile)"; _n="${3:-40}"
1116	      else
1117	        _lf="$logf"; _n="${2:-40}"
1118	        case "${3:-}" in 1|2|3) _lf="$logf.$3" ;; esac
1119	      fi
1120	      if [ -f "$_lf" ]; then command tail -n "$_n" "$_lf"; else
1121	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: no log file at $_lf" >&2; return 1; fi
1122	      ;;
1123	    auth)
1124	      # One-time device login → stores a ghu_ token copilot-api can exchange.
1125	      _copilot_ensure_pkg || return 1
1126	      printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: launching copilot-api device login ..."
1127	      if [ "$(_copilot_pkg_flavor)" = "original" ]; then
1128	        "$(_copilot_pkg_bin)" auth
1129	      else
1130	        "$(_copilot_pkg_bin)" auth --provider copilot
1131	      fi
1132	      ;;
1133	    reinstall)
1134	      # Force a clean re-install of the pinned spec (normally only needed if the
1135	      # prefix got corrupted — a version bump re-installs on its own via the stamp).
1136	      printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: removing $(_copilot_pkg_prefix) ..."
1137	      command rm -rf -- "$(_copilot_pkg_prefix)"
1138	      _copilot_ensure_pkg || return 1
1139	      printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: installed $(_copilot_pkg) → $(_copilot_pkg_bin)"
1140	      ;;
1141	    whoami|usage)
1142	      # Real login check: exchanges the stored token against GitHub and prints
1143	      # the account / plan / quota. Fails loudly if the token is missing/expired.
1144	      if [ ! -f "$HOME/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token" ]; then
1145	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: not authenticated — run 'copilot-proxy auth' first." >&2
1146	        return 1
1147	      fi
1148	      if [ "$(_copilot_pkg_flavor)" = "original" ]; then
1149	        _copilot_ensure_pkg || return 1
1150	        "$(_copilot_pkg_bin)" check-usage
1151	      elif _copilot_alive; then
1152	        # Fork has no check-usage subcommand; its /usage endpoint serves the
1153	        # GitHub quota payload (same data as the bundled /usage-viewer).
1154	        if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1155	          command curl -fsS --max-time 5 "$(_copilot_base)/usage" | jq '{
1156	            plan: (.copilot_plan // .access_type_sku // "unknown"),
1157	            quota_reset: (.quota_reset_date // null),
1158	            quotas: ((.quota_snapshots // {}) | map_values(
1159	              if type == "object" then
1160	                {remaining, entitlement, percent_remaining, unlimited}
1161	              else . end))
1162	          }'
1163	        else
1164	          command curl -fsS --max-time 5 "$(_copilot_base)/usage"
1165	        fi
1166	      else
1167	        # Proxy down → the fork's `debug` still validates auth state / paths.
1168	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: not running — showing auth/debug info instead of quota." >&2
1169	        _copilot_ensure_pkg || return 1
1170	        "$(_copilot_pkg_bin)" debug
1171	      fi
1172	      ;;
1173	    shim)
1174	      # shim [on|off|status] — persist the toggle, and start/stop it live if the
1175	      # fork is already running.
1176	      local sf; sf="$(_copilot_shim_state)"
1177	      case "${2:-status}" in
1178	        on)
1179	          command mkdir -p "$(command dirname "$sf")"; printf 'on\n' >"$sf"
1180	          if _copilot_alive; then
1181	            _copilot_shim_start && printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: shim ON → $(_copilot_shim_base) (→ $(_copilot_base))"
1182	          else
1183	            printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: shim enabled; will start with the proxy ('copilot-proxy start')."
1184	          fi
1185	          printf '%s\n' "  NOTE: restart Claude Code so it picks up ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=$(_copilot_shim_base)"
1186	          ;;
1187	        off)
1188	          printf 'off\n' >"$sf"; _copilot_shim_stop
1189	          printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: shim OFF (clients use $(_copilot_base) directly)"
1190	          printf '%s\n' "  NOTE: restart Claude Code to point back at $(_copilot_base)"
1191	          ;;
1192	        status|*)
1193	          if _copilot_shim_enabled; then
1194	            printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: shim ON ($(_copilot_shim_alive && echo up || echo down)) on $(_copilot_shim_base)"
1195	          else
1196	            printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: shim off"
1197	          fi
1198	          ;;
1199	      esac
1200	      ;;
1201	    -h|--help|help)
1202	      printf '%s\n' "Usage: copilot-proxy [start|stop|restart|status|doctor [--live]|logs [shim|N [gen]]|shim [on|off|status]|whoami|auth|reinstall]"
1203	      printf '%s\n' "  doctor (alias: test)  diagnose prereqs, auth, proxy, Claude catalog (direct vs via"
1204	      printf '%s\n' "                        Clash), upstream reachability and Codex Apps."
1205	      printf '%s\n' "                        --live probes Apps and costs 1 inference quota unit."
1206	      printf '%s\n' "  COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY    auto|always|never|http://127.0.0.1:PORT  (default auto)"
1207	      printf '%s\n' "                        auto attaches --proxy-env when proxy-status finds a local proxy."
1208	      printf '%s\n' "  reinstall             wipe + re-install the pinned package (a version bump"
1209	      printf '%s\n' "                        re-installs on its own; this is for a corrupted prefix)."
1210	      ;;
1211	    *)
1212	      printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: unknown action '$action' (try --help)" >&2
1213	      return 1
1214	      ;;
1215	  esac
1216	}
1217	
1218	# --- session wrapper (Layer 1: one-off, zero file writes) ------------------------
1219	
1220	# Run any command with the copilot-proxy env injected (per-process only —
1221	# nothing is written to disk). Auto-starts the proxy when it isn't answering.
1222	# GOTCHA (verified 2026-07): current Claude Code lets the settings.local.json
1223	# env block beat inherited shell env, so this does NOT win inside a project
1224	# where `copilot-here on` pins something else — `copilot-here off` first.
1225	# Example:
1226	#   copilot-run claude                      # raw Claude Code on the proxy
1227	#   copilot-run specstory run claude        # specstory-wrapped session
1228	copilot-run() {
1229	  if [ "$#" -eq 0 ]; then
1230	    printf '%s\n' "Usage: copilot-run <cmd> [args...]   (injects ANTHROPIC_* proxy env)" >&2
1231	    return 1
1232	  fi
1233	  if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1234	    printf '%s\n' "copilot-run: jq is required to build the model role profile" >&2
1235	    return 1
1236	  fi
1237	  if ! _copilot_alive; then
1238	    copilot-proxy start || return 1
1239	  fi
1240	  # If the shim is enabled but not up (e.g. toggled on after the proxy started),
1241	  # bring it up now so ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL below resolves to it.
1242	  if _copilot_shim_enabled && ! _copilot_shim_alive; then _copilot_shim_start; fi
1243	  local profile model fable opus sonnet haiku
1244	  profile="$(_copilot_model_profile_json "$(_copilot_default_model)")" || return 1
1245	  model="$(printf '%s' "$profile" | jq -r '.main')"
1246	  fable="$(printf '%s' "$profile" | jq -r '.fable')"
1247	  opus="$(printf '%s' "$profile" | jq -r '.opus')"
1248	  sonnet="$(printf '%s' "$profile" | jq -r '.sonnet')"
1249	  haiku="$(printf '%s' "$profile" | jq -r '.haiku')"
1250	  # Opt-in quota savers (COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET=1): prepended as NAME=VALUE args
1251	  # to `env`. Off by default — they degrade the Claude Code UX a little.
1252	  if [ "${COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET:-0}" = "1" ]; then
1253	    set -- \
1254	      CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER="0" \
1255	      CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION="false" \
1256	      CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY="0" \
1257	      DISABLE_NON_ESSENTIAL_MODEL_CALLS="1" \
1258	      "$@"
1259	  fi
1260	  # `command env` (not bare var-prefix) so the vars are strictly per-process:
1261	  # POSIX var-prefix on a *function* call would leak into the current shell.
1262	  command env \
1263	    ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="$(_copilot_client_base)" \
1264	    ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN="dummy" \
1265	    ANTHROPIC_MODEL="$model" \
1266	    ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL="$fable" \
1267	    ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL="$opus" \
1268	    ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL="$sonnet" \
1269	    ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL="$haiku" \
1270	    ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL="$haiku" \
1271	    CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC="1" \
1272	    "$@"
1273	}
1274	
1275	# Pick the best model for Codex from the raw gateway catalog. This is
1276	# deliberately NOT _copilot_pick_best_model: Claude Code prefers native Claude
1277	# when entitled, while Codex should stay on a native Responses-capable OpenAI
1278	# model as long as one is served. Claude/Gemini remain useful last-resort
1279	# Responses Lite fallbacks.
1280	_copilot_codex_pick_best_model() {
1281	  local models preferred c
1282	  models="$(command cat | command sed 's/\[1m\]$//' | command sort -u)"
1283	  [ -n "$models" ] || return 1
1284	
1285	  for preferred in \
1286	    gpt-5.6-sol gpt-5.6-terra gpt-5.5 gpt-5.4 gpt-5.3-codex \
1287	    gpt-5.6-luna gpt-5.4-mini gpt-5-mini
1288	  do
1289	    if printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -qxF "$preferred"; then
1290	      printf '%s' "$preferred"
1291	      return 0
1292	    fi
1293	  done
1294	  c="$(printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -E '^gpt-' | command grep -viE 'mini|nano|luna' \
1295	        | command sort | command tail -1)"
1296	  if [ -n "$c" ]; then printf '%s' "$c"; return 0; fi
1297	  c="$(printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -iE 'codex' | command sort | command tail -1)"
1298	  if [ -n "$c" ]; then printf '%s' "$c"; return 0; fi
1299	  c="$(printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -E '^gpt-' | command sort | command tail -1)"
1300	  if [ -n "$c" ]; then printf '%s' "$c"; return 0; fi
1301	
1302	  for preferred in \
1303	    claude-fable-5 \
1304	    claude-opus-5 claude-opus-4-8 claude-opus-4-7 claude-opus-4-6 \
1305	    claude-sonnet-5 claude-sonnet-4-6 claude-sonnet-4-5 \
1306	    claude-opus-4-5 claude-haiku-4-5
1307	  do
1308	    if printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -qxF "$preferred"; then
1309	      printf '%s' "$preferred"
1310	      return 0
1311	    fi
1312	  done
1313	  c="$(printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -E '^claude-' | command sort | command tail -1)"
1314	  if [ -n "$c" ]; then printf '%s' "$c"; return 0; fi
1315	
1316	  c="$(printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -E '^gemini-' | command grep -viE 'flash' \
1317	        | command sort | command tail -1)"
1318	  if [ -n "$c" ]; then printf '%s' "$c"; return 0; fi
1319	  c="$(printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -E '^gemini-' | command sort | command tail -1)"
1320	  if [ -n "$c" ]; then printf '%s' "$c"; return 0; fi
1321	
1322	  printf '%s\n' "$models" | command sort | command tail -1
1323	}
1324	
1325	# Effective SpecStory Codex command, matching SpecStory's own precedence.
1326	# `specstory run ... -c` replaces this command wholesale, so callers must append
1327	# to this value rather than fall back to a bare `codex` and silently lose the
1328	# configured reasoning / sandbox flags.
1329	_copilot_specstory_codex_cmd() {
1330	  local f cmd=''
1331	  for f in ".specstory/cli/config.toml" "$HOME/.specstory/cli/config.toml"; do
1332	    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
1333	    cmd="$(command sed -n \
1334	      -e "s/^[[:space:]]*codex_cmd[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*\"\([^\"]*\)\".*/\1/p" \
1335	      -e "s/^[[:space:]]*codex_cmd[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*'\([^']*\)'.*/\1/p" \
1336	      "$f" 2>/dev/null | command head -n 1)"
1337	    if [ -n "$cmd" ]; then break; fi
1338	  done
1339	  printf '%s' "${cmd:-codex}"
1340	}
1341	
1342	# Codex stores one global models_cache.json without provider namespacing. A
1343	# custom Copilot gateway refresh can therefore replace the first-party metadata
1344	# catalog with the gateway's much smaller adapter subset, making a bundled model
1345	# such as gpt-5.6-sol fall back to generic metadata. Pin this launcher to the
1346	# catalog bundled with the installed Codex binary instead. The binary version is
1347	# part of the path, so upgrades regenerate automatically while repeat launches
1348	# avoid another `codex debug models --bundled` subprocess.
1349	_copilot_codex_catalog_file() {
1350	  command -v codex >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
1351	  command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
1352	
1353	  local raw_version version cache_dir catalog_file tmp
1354	  raw_version="$(command codex --version 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
1355	  version="$(printf '%s' "$raw_version" | command sed 's/[^[:alnum:]._-]/_/g')"
1356	  [ -n "$version" ] || return 1
1357	
1358	  cache_dir="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/copilot-proxy/codex-models"
1359	  catalog_file="$cache_dir/$version.json"
1360	  if [ -s "$catalog_file" ] \
1361	     && jq -e '.models | type == "array" and length > 0' "$catalog_file" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1362	    printf '%s' "$catalog_file"
1363	    return 0
1364	  fi
1365	
1366	  command mkdir -p "$cache_dir" || return 1
1367	  tmp="$(command mktemp "$cache_dir/.catalog.XXXXXX")" || return 1
1368	  if command codex debug models --bundled >"$tmp" 2>/dev/null \
1369	     && jq -e '.models | type == "array" and length > 0' "$tmp" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1370	    command mv -- "$tmp" "$catalog_file"
1371	    printf '%s' "$catalog_file"
1372	  else
1373	    command rm -f -- "$tmp"
1374	    return 1
1375	  fi
1376	}
1377	
1378	# One-off Codex session backed by the local Copilot gateway. Provider settings
1379	# are CLI overrides only: plain `codex`, ~/.codex/config.toml and project config
1380	# remain untouched. The alias-like sibling below exists for Claude wrapper
1381	# muscle memory; both names have identical zero-persistence semantics.
1382	codex-copilot() {
1383	  local ss="auto" arg explicit_model=0 model='' catalog='' models=''
1384	  case "${1:-}" in
1385	    --no-specstory) ss="never"; shift ;;
1386	    --specstory)    shift ;;
1387	    -h|--help)
1388	      printf '%s\n' "Usage: codex-copilot [--no-specstory] [codex args...]"
1389	      printf '%s\n' "  One-off Codex session on the local Copilot Responses gateway."
1390	      printf '%s\n' "  Auto model: OpenAI/Codex > Claude > Gemini > other served chat models."
1391	      printf '%s\n' "  Alias: codex-copilot-once"
1392	      return 0 ;;
1393	  esac
1394	
1395	  if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1396	    printf '%s\n' "codex-copilot: jq is required for live model selection" >&2
1397	    return 1
1398	  fi
1399	  if ! _copilot_alive; then copilot-proxy start || return 1; fi

1433	  # auth contract and is ignored by our unauthenticated localhost listener.

1493	codex-copilot-once() { codex-copilot "$@"; }
1494	
1495	# --- specstory `-c` passthrough (why the base command must come from config) ----
1496	#
1497	# specstory's `-c/--command` REPLACES the provider's configured command — it does
1498	# NOT append to it. The shipped config says as much: "Use of these is equivalent
1499	# to -c \"custom command\"" — same slot, last write wins. So a hardcoded
1500	# `-c "claude $*"` silently drops every flag in `claude_cmd` the moment
1501	# claude-copilot has args to pass through.
1502	#
1503	# Symptom that found this (verified 2026-07, specstory 2.5.0): with
1504	# `claude_cmd = "claude --dangerously-skip-permissions"` in the specstory config,
1505	# a bare `claude-copilot-once` took the no-`-c` branch and correctly ran in
1506	# bypass-permissions mode, but `claude-copilot-once --resume X` took the `-c`
1507	# branch and fell back to ~/.claude/settings.json's permissions.defaultMode
1508	# ("auto"). Same wrapper, opposite permission mode, no warning either way.
1509	#
1510	# Deriving the base command from the config keeps specstory the single source of
1511	# truth for BOTH branches: change `claude_cmd` there and both paths follow.
1512	# `--no-specstory` deliberately does NOT inherit it (opting out of specstory
1513	# means opting out of its config too).
1514	
1515	# Effective `claude_cmd`, honouring specstory's own precedence:
1516	#   project ./.specstory/cli/config.toml > user ~/.specstory/cli/config.toml
1517	#   > bare `claude`
1518	# Matches UNCOMMENTED assignments only — both shipped configs carry a commented
1519	# `# claude_cmd = "claude"` example, and matching that would re-introduce the very
1520	# bug this exists to fix. Handles TOML's double- and single-quoted strings.
1521	_copilot_specstory_claude_cmd() {
1522	  local f cmd=''
1523	  for f in ".specstory/cli/config.toml" "$HOME/.specstory/cli/config.toml"; do
1524	    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
1525	    cmd="$(command sed -n \
1526	      -e "s/^[[:space:]]*claude_cmd[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*\"\([^\"]*\)\".*/\1/p" \
1527	      -e "s/^[[:space:]]*claude_cmd[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*'\([^']*\)'.*/\1/p" \
1528	      "$f" 2>/dev/null | command head -n 1)"
1529	    if [ -n "$cmd" ]; then break; fi
1530	  done
1531	  printf '%s' "${cmd:-claude}"
1532	}
1533	
1534	# Single-quote ONE argument for embedding in specstory's `-c` command STRING.
```

```text
443	# End-to-end against a mock upstream that withholds its response headers the way
444	# copilot-api does while a reasoning model thinks. Guards the four-way split the
445	# keepalive introduced; see pitfalls/copilot-proxy-openai-model-silent-stall.md.
446	@test "shim keepalive fires only on slow streams, leaving fast + non-stream untouched" {
447	  command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 || skip "bun not installed"
448	  command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || skip "jq not installed"
449	  local shim="$SOURCE_DIR/dot_config/shell/copilot-throttle-shim.js"
450	  cat >"$TMP/keepalive.js" <<'JS'
451	const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
452	const up = Bun.serve({ port: 0, idleTimeout: 60, async fetch(req) {
453	  const u = new URL(req.url);
454	  await sleep(Number(u.searchParams.get("delay") ?? 0));
455	  if (u.searchParams.get("mode") === "status")
456	    return new Response('{"error":"nope"}', { status: 400, headers: { "content-type": "application/json" } });
457	  return new Response("event: message_start\ndata: {}\n\nevent: message_stop\ndata: {}\n\n",
458	    { headers: { "content-type": "text/event-stream" } });
459	} });
460	process.env.COPILOT_SHIM_PORT = "0";
461	process.env.COPILOT_SHIM_UPSTREAM = `http://localhost:${up.port}`;
462	process.env.COPILOT_SHIM_PING_MS = "150";
463	process.env.COPILOT_SHIM_PING_AFTER_MS = "100";
464	process.env.COPILOT_SHIM_STALL_MS = "5000";
465	const { startServer } = await import(process.argv[2]);
466	const shim = startServer();
467	const call = async (q, stream = true) => {
468	  const r = await fetch(`http://localhost:${shim.port}/v1/messages${q}`, { method: "POST",
469	    headers: { "content-type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ model: "m", stream }) });
470	  const body = await r.text();
471	  return { status: r.status, ct: r.headers.get("content-type"),
472	    pings: (body.match(/^: /gm) ?? []).length,
473	    events: (body.match(/^event: (\S+)/gm) ?? []).map((s) => s.slice(7)) };
474	};
475	const out = {
476	  slow:    await call("?delay=800"),
477	  fast:    await call("?delay=0"),
478	  plain:   await call("?delay=800&mode=status", false),
479	  lateErr: await call("?delay=800&mode=status"),
480	};
481	console.log(JSON.stringify(out));
482	shim.stop(true); up.stop(true);
483	JS
484	  run bash -c "bun '$TMP/keepalive.js' '$shim' 2>&1 | tail -n 1"
485	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
486	  local j="$output"
487	  # Slow stream: comment frames while the upstream is silent, real events after.
488	  [ "$(printf '%s' "$j" | jq -r '.slow.pings > 0')" = "true" ]
489	  [ "$(printf '%s' "$j" | jq -r '.slow.events | join(",")')" = "message_start,message_stop" ]
490	  # Fast stream: inside the grace window, so nothing is injected at all.
491	  [ "$(printf '%s' "$j" | jq -r '.fast.pings')" = "0" ]
492	  # Non-streaming request: never eligible — real 400 and the JSON body verbatim.
493	  [ "$(printf '%s' "$j" | jq -r '.plain.status')" = "400" ]
494	  [ "$(printf '%s' "$j" | jq -r '.plain.ct')" = "application/json" ]
495	  [ "$(printf '%s' "$j" | jq -r '.plain.pings')" = "0" ]
496	  # A non-2xx that arrives AFTER the early commit can only be an SSE error event.
497	  [ "$(printf '%s' "$j" | jq -r '.lateErr.status')" = "200" ]
498	  [ "$(printf '%s' "$j" | jq -r '.lateErr.events | join(",")')" = "error" ]
499	}
```
